jobs.title: Data Architect - Azure
jobs.description:
Data Architect - Azure / Fabric

Salary: up to £85,000
Location: West Yorkshire (1-2 days p/w)

About the Opportunity

Our client is a fast-growing RegTech group providing identity verification, AML, and digital compliance solutions to regulated businesses. Following a recent acquisition, they are bringing two established platforms together and investing heavily in the data foundations that will underpin the combined group.

The Role

As a Data Architect, you will define how commercial and customer data works across the combined estate, starting with the contract and entitlement model that several in-flight programmes depend on a CRM rebuild in HubSpot, a finance transformation onto NetSuite, a new commercial model, automated usage rating, and a platform integration programme.
This is a hands-on architecture role, not a governance-only one. You will be modelling, profiling real data, and writing the specifications that engineering and finance teams build from. Our client is open about the starting position: the data landscape is fragmented and the two platforms model the same concepts differently. That is the problem, and it is an interesting one.

Key Responsibilities

Produce an enterprise data entity map across core business entities, identifying systems of record, relationships, and conflicts.
Establish canonical definitions and named owners with commercial, finance, product, and engineering.
Design the canonical contract and entitlement model, supporting prepaid wallet, subscription-with-overage, and a new blended model - with effective dating, versioning, and full lineage from invoice line back to usage event.
Define the target quote-to-cash flow, keeping operational billing and analytical reporting paths cleanly separated.
Profile contract, entitlement, and usage data, and assess quality and migration remediation.
Specify the data contracts between CRM, rating/billing, and finance, and the requirements for usage rating and metering.

Skills & Experience

Strong enterprise data modelling across conceptual, logical, and physical layers in a multi-system estate, with real examples of entity maps and canonical models produced.
Experience modelling contract, entitlement, subscription, or usage-based billing data - temporal modelling and point-in-time reconstruction are non-negotiable.
Data architecture in a regulated environment: auditability, lineage, retention, and PII handling under UK GDPR.
Ability to design both OLTP and OLAP pathways without conflating them.
Data governance in practice - glossaries, ownership, stewardship, data quality.
The ability to get commercial, finance, product, and engineering people into a room and come out with agreed definitions.

Key Technologies

Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2)
Power BI and medallion architecture patterns
CDC, streaming ingestion, and entity resolution
SQL Server, Azure SQL Database, MySQL, Cosmos DB
Azure integration services (API Management, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Functions, Logic Apps)
Entra ID, Key Vault, Azure Policy, Purview
HubSpot, NetSuite, and Azure DevOps

Desirable

Microsoft Fabric, or directly transferable depth on AWS or GCP data platforms.
Experience in RegTech, fintech, or another compliance-driven domain.
Post-acquisition integration experience - two estates, two data models, one target.

Benefits

10% Bonus
Private Healthcare
Lots more!

Why Apply?

This is a rare opportunity to define the data model an entire group's commercial future depends on, at the point where the decisions are still open. Reporting to the Group Director of Architecture, you will have genuine autonomy over your domain and visible impact across several major transformation programmes.
Apply now, or contact ash.medley@fruitiongroup.com for more information.
We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

jobs.description:
ABOUT ORGANOX:

OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543) strives to fulfil its mission of "Contributing to Society through Healthcare" by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

Position Summary

The Software Engineer, Quality & Process will utilise their extensive experience in Software Quality Assurance, particularly in cloud solutions used in medical applications and embedded medical device development. This role will play a critical role in ensuring our cloud platform and medical devices meet the stringent quality and regulatory standards required for medical devices.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a fast-growing organisation in a strategic role that will have significant impact on the company's digital offering and contribute to how organ transplants are delivered. While this position is in the Software Development team, the role works in partnership with the quality function.

This is an on-site position in Oxford with flexibility.

Listed below are the major responsibilities of the role and a brief description of some of the key tasks to be performed. This list is not totally exhaustive.

Major Responsibilities

Under direction from the Director, Embedded Software Development, the Software Engineer, Quality & Process will be responsible for:

Quality Assurance & Testing:

Development, implementation and maintenance of the Software Technical File for the products, defining the documental strategy and facilitating submissions
Act as primary interface between Software and Quality and Regulatory teams
Participate in the development and maintenance of software processes that meets all relevant Regulatory requirements, including but not limited to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Working Instructions (WI)
Define and execute improvements activities, including but not limited to Corrective Actions Preventive Actions (CAPAs)
Oversee the SOUP (Software of Unknown Provenance) and Tools validations securing compliance with internal QMS (Quality Management System)

Compliance & Documentation:

Create all the software related documentation, including requirements, design, test reports and traceability, ensuring compliance and excellence in the rigour applied including derived outcome.
Develop templates for software documentation and facilitate their integration with the software development toolchain, including the Continuous Integration/ Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) artifacts.
Proactively manage partnerships, preparing and maintaining detailed documentation, including test plans, test cases, test scripts and test reports.

Risk and Cybersecurity Risk Management:

Drive the software risk analysis activities, including the development and maintenance of the Failure Mode Effect Analysis (FMEA), identification of mitigations and their inclusion in the design input documentation
Drive the cybersecurity activities including threat modelling, penetration tests, identification, assessment and mitigation of software-related and cybersecurity risks, including those associated with the outsourced development and testing processes.
Drive a key focus to develop and maintain a risk management plan in accordance with relevant standards and frameworks, ensuring all identified risks are documented and mitigated effectively.
Take the lead to ensure regular and comprehensive review and update of software related risk through the software FMEA, to address any emerging risks during the software development lifecycle.

Collaboration & Communication:

Role models effective stakeholder collaboration, working closely with software developers, product managers and other partners to understand requirements and design effective testing strategies.
Ensures timely communication of findings, risks and recommendations, which are effective and clear to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Adhere to and role model the spirit of OrganOx's Code of Conduct and all other company policies

Requirements

Skills & Experience

Demonstrated experience in a similar role, preferably within the medical device industry.
Proven experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on cloud solutions and software for Medical Devices (essential)
Strong understanding of software development, testing methodologies, tools and processes (essential)
Proven experience applying regulatory standards for Medical Devices (e.g., ISO 13485, FDA regulations, EN 62304, IEC 62366) (essential)
Engineering experience in software risk management (ISO 14971), including cybersecurity risk management (essential)
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail (essential)
Strong communication and collaboration skills (essential)
Proven experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and IoMT solutions (desirable)
Knowledge of medical device software lifecycle processes (essential)
Familiarity in programming languages such as Python, Java, C# or C/C++ (desirable)
Proven experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines (desirable)
Familiarity with relevant cybersecurity standards and frameworks (e.g., IEC 62443, NIST Cybersecurity Framework (essential)

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
Relevant certifications in software quality assurance or testing (e.g., ISTQB).

Benefits

At OrganOx, we value innovation, evidence, integrity, teamwork, respect, and passion. We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, including healthcare and retirement plans. We support work-life balance and provide opportunities for ongoing professional development.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation race, or any other characteristics protected by law.

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

In this role, you will work within a cross-functional product team responsible for modernising the user experience, backend services and cloud platform capabilities of one of WTW’s strategic cloud platforms.

You will contribute to a business-critical distributed compute platform that executes large-scale insurance modelling workloads across the organisation. The platform dynamically provisions Azure compute resources, runs computationally intensive jobs submitted by multiple business applications and provides a shared cloud foundation for analytical services.

The role combines frontend and backend development, cloud-native engineering and modern software engineering practices. You’ll help replace legacy technologies, rebuild AngularJS portals, modernise backend services, introduce Infrastructure as Code, migrate workloads to Azure Container Apps and improve deployment automation and operational resilience.

Working alongside experienced platform engineers, architects, product owners, DevOps engineers and QA specialists, you’ll help transform the current platform into a modern Azure-native platform while gaining deep knowledge of cloud platform engineering and distributed systems.

Improve platform reliability, scalability and performance through well-tested engineering changes.

Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture.

Modernise legacy platform functionality while preserving business continuity.
Implement scalable, maintainable and secure software following modern engineering practices.

Contribute to zero-downtime deployment improvements.

jobs.title: Principal Architect
jobs.description:
What Makes Us, Us  

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!  

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT FOR US

SimCorp is investing in the integration layer of SimCorp One. We are looking for a Platform Test Architect to extend our platform capabilities for automated, repeatable cross-system testing, the crucial layer between system tests and end-to-end flows. Your work will enable product and platform teams to validate release candidates after the merge gate and qualify deliveries at scale across our service ecosystem.

You will work closely with our Application Test Architect to cover the full testing spectrum. In addition, you will collaborate with architects responsible for platform services, engineering pipelines, and infrastructure to ensure testing capabilities integrate seamlessly into our delivery processes. Your focus will be on platform capabilities and execution, while our Application Test Architect leads application-side practices and client-facing testing coordination. Together with other architects, you will close today’s gaps and establish modern, scalable testing as a first-class engineering concern.

What You Will Be Responsible For

To ensure success in this role, you will be involved in the following areas:

Integration testing platform: Design and deliver a shared platform for integration testing of SimCorp One services (Microsoft Azure, Azure Kubernetes Service, .NET), enabling teams to add, run, and automate cross-system tests efficiently and repeatedly.
Quality gates: Operationalize post-merge quality gates for release candidates, including contract and application programming interface testing, integration suites, sanity and smoke tests, and define the process for exceptions or waivers.
Drive requirements: Help standardize testing capabilities in our eco-system and define how systems can test integration patterns.
Adoption and enablement: Drive organization-wide adoption through templates, reference implementations, and recommended practices that teams can extend.
Test data and environments: Define the strategy for test data and environments, including synthetic data, data masking, and production-equivalent snapshots, in collaboration with our operations and platform teams.
Performance and load testing: Lay the groundwork for performance and load testing as a future phase, including tooling choices, service level agreements, and monitoring.
Documentation and alignment: Document and align at scale by authoring reference architecture documents, patterns, and playbooks; publishing via the Architecture Hub; and measuring adoption and impact.

Your role will be pivotal in ensuring that SimCorp remains an efficient, transparent leader in financial services, directly contributing to our strategic objectives and long-term success.

What We Value

To ensure success in this role, possessing one or more of the following skills will be highly beneficial:

Integration testing experience: Experience in building integration testing capabilities for service-based architectures at scale, ideally in a business-to-business or software-as-a-service context.
Cloud and platform expertise: Experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure Kubernetes Service; strong background in .NET.
Testing strategies: Knowledge of testing strategies, including black/grey/white box testing, consumer-driven contract testing, integration layering, pipeline governance, and quality gates.
Test data management: Practical experience with synthetic data approaches, data masking, and designing environments for testability.
Testing economy: Optimization of cost-of-testing, including experience with shift-left patterns and ability to formulate various tradeoffs when adhering to economic testing approaches.
Automation mindset: An automation-first mindset, with a track record of improving lead-time-for-changes, minimizing escaped defects, reducing failure rates, and increasing recovery speed.
Stakeholder management: Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive consensus across platform, application, Site Reliability Engineering, and product teams, and to remain resilient in complex or ambiguous situations.
Performance and security testing: Experience with performance and load testing, resilience testing, or security testing integration is a plus.
Compliance and best practices: Exposure to compliance frameworks such as Service Organization Control 2 (SOC2) or Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) is beneficial but not required.
Developer experience: Experience curating recommended practices and developer experience artifacts is valued.

These skills will empower you to contribute significantly to our service delivery strategy and help maintain the highest standards of communication and efficiency for our platforms and services.

How We Work

At SimCorp, we believe that our success is driven by the collaboration and innovation of our people. Here is what you can expect and what we hope you'll bring to our team:

Community leadership: You will be a key driver in the Testing Technical Collaboration Council, collaborating daily with platform and application architects, product owners, product managers, and value streams.
Decision rights and alignment: You will have architectural decision rights and ensure alignment with adjacent core areas, including security, compliance, Site Reliability Engineering, and product.
Testing review: As part of our architectural review of system and services, you will be responsible for reviewing the testing strategy of the system
Enablement and scaling: The role is focused on building foundations and guidelines for other teams to scale; documentation and alignment are essential.
Coaching and enablement: Parts of your time will be dedicated to the coaching and enablement of our Tech Leads and Engineering teams, with most of your time focused on architecture decisions and design.

Benefits   

Flexible working hours and hybrid model - 2 days in the office, 3 days remote
Modern office (next to Wilanowska metro station) with quiet zones and ergonomic workstations
Base salary with annual bonus structure 
Holiday allowance upon a 2-week vacation
Occasional remote work across Poland and international options available (up to 24 days domestic, 20 days international per year - subject to internal policy)
Employer-paid Medicover Platinum healthcare package (employee-paid family upgrade available)
Multisport card with 75% employer contribution
Unum group life insurance (employee-paid upgrade available)
Medicover travel insurance for private trips and global business travel insurance
Possibility to join Deutsche Börse Group Share Plan (eligible after 1 year)
Copyrights program for certain roles 
Possibility to develop your career in an international environment
Professional training and courses provided by SimCorp
Polish language classes for foreign employees; German and English classes based on business needs
Integration events, volunteering initiatives and employee-led clubs

NEXT STEPS 

Please click below to apply to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp has to offer regarding salary, benefits, and perks. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process, we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Nasz dział Industrial Platform Solutions rozwija kompetencje związane z cyfryzacją przemysłu i systemami Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES). Tworzymy rozwiązania łączące świat IT z automatyką przemysłową, wspierając zakłady produkcyjne w obszarze integracji systemów, analizy danych procesowych i nowoczesnej produkcji cyfrowej.

Pracujemy blisko biznesu i rzeczywistych procesów produkcyjnych. Stawiamy na partnerską współpracę, prostotę rozwiązań i odpowiedzialność za dostarczane systemy.

O zespole i projektach

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego i wdrażającego rozwiązania MES oparte o technologie AVEVA (Wonderware), m.in. Platformę Systemową, Model-Driven MES, Historian oraz rozwiązania integracyjne.

Realizujemy międzynarodowe projekty dla dużych firm produkcyjnych z branży spożywczej, chemicznej i przemysłowej. Obecnie prowadzimy rollouty systemów MES w zakładach na kilku kontynentach, rozwijając rozwiązania po zakończonym wdrożeniu pilotażowym.

Pracujemy projektowo – w zależności od etapu wdrożenia możesz uczestniczyć zarówno w rozwoju nowych funkcjonalności, integracji systemów, rolloutach, upgrade’ach, jak i uruchomieniach produkcyjnych.

To rola dla osoby, która dobrze odnajduje się na styku IT, systemów przemysłowych i integracji. Szukamy inżyniera, który rozumie środowisko produkcyjne, potrafi pracować z danymi i systemami MES oraz swobodnie porusza się w technicznych aspektach wdrożeń.

Pracujemy w pełni zdalnie, z możliwością korzystania z biur we Wrocławiu, Katowicach, Poznaniu i Gdańsku.

Dlaczego warto?

Job Description

We are looking for a forward‑thinking Solution Architect – Cloud Web Portals (Angular & AEM)
to lead the design and delivery of modern, scalable web portals on Angular and Adobe Experience Manager. Your work will shape intuitive, secure, high‑impact digital experiences used by thousands of users across our organization.

The Role

Act as the design authority for enterprise applications within your domain.
Translate business needs into clear, scalable functional and technical architectures.
Lead high‑level analysis and application design for complex and critical initiatives.
Ensure alignment with Enterprise Architecture standards and drive integration across systems.
Evaluate the feasibility of new initiatives and provide budget and workload estimates.
Support Enterprise Architecture in assessing new technologies and standards.
Guide development teams by validating specifications and ensuring architectural consistency.
Navigate change and complexity to maintain and evolve critical applications.

Requirements
Must‑Have

10 years of software development experience, including 3+ years as an Application Architect for cloud‑based web portals.
Proven expertise in Microsoft Azure and Angular.
Strong understanding of content management systems, cloud computing, and enterprise architecture.
Excellent communication skills, able to adapt to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to solve complex technical challenges.
Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Nice‑to‑Have

Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (such as TOGAF).
Experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).

About Us

Why join us

Embark on your new adventure at Euroclear, and work at the heart of the global capital markets. We connect over 2,000 financial institutions across the globe. As an open and resilient infrastructure, we contribute to the stability of the financial markets. We help clients cut through complexity, lower costs, and mitigate risks of financial transactions. At Euroclear, we have the clear ambition to use our key role to facilitate and accelerate a sustainable global financial system.

Work closely with inspiring, supportive and engaged colleagues from more than 80 different countries.
Practice your talents in a highly professional international environment.
Join a learning and development environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training.
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.

Find your own optimal balance within our hybrid working model, where you can connect at the office 8 days a month and also benefit from remote working.

The Group Digital Capabilities (GDC) division contributes to Euroclear’s competitiveness by delivering reliable and sustainable IT solutions for the financial securities markets. jobs.title: Operations Quality Principal Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Job Title:
Enterprise AI & Quality Insights Architect

Location:
Warsaw, Poland (Hybrid Model)

Hiring Manager:
Cynthia Harvell

Roche Digital Technology (RDT)
is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Join our dynamic team as an Enterprise AI & Quality Insights Architect, where you will directly shape how artificial intelligence and advanced data platforms transform quality operations across our global network. In this role, you will lead the architectural design and deployment of cutting-edge NLP, LLM, and agentic workflows within a highly regulated healthcare environment. This is a unique opportunity to combine strategic product ownership, robust AI scaling, and matrix leadership to drive meaningful digital transformation in quality management.

The opportunity:

Enterprise AI Architecture, Scaling & Strategy

Enterprise AI Platform Management: Design, scale, and deploy robust machine learning and NLP pipelines utilizing approved enterprise data platforms, primarily focusing on Dataiku and Azure ML Studio layers
Agentic Framework Implementation: Evaluate and deploy advanced AI solutions. Utilize the Claude Agent SDK or comparable approved SDKs as targeted implementation options for complex use cases that genuinely require custom, automated agents to navigate cross-system data silos
AI Use-Case Backlog Governance: Architect and mature our global AI Use-Case Backlog. Guide the deployment of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate initial sorting, risk-grading, and real-time categorization of complex quality data
Sustainable Data Infrastructure: Oversee the conceptual data modeling and integration pipelines feeding into core analytics repositories (such as Snowflake and AWS). Partner with builders to translate complex datasets into high-performing enterprise business intelligence views

Strategic Product Ownership & Automated Governance

Agile Product Architecture: Assume formal Product Owner and architectural design oversight for core Quality Insight platforms, dashboards, and automation frameworks
DevOps & Workflow Optimization: Establish and Champion clean repository management, version control, and collaborative code review practices via Git. Drive standardized automation workflows utilizing Jira and Confluence to optimize the subchapter's intake pipeline and eliminate communication latency

GxP Compliance, CSV Integration & Matrix Leadership

Computerized System Validation (CSV) Alignment: Ensure all deployed AI models, automated scripts, and data pipelines adhere to computerized system validation protocols under GxP, US FDA (21 CFR Part 820), and ISO 13485 standards. Guide the team in authoring, reviewing, and executing technical validation documentation for data integrity
Cross-Functional Strategy: Partner directly with Quality Site Heads, Business Leaders, and global cross-functional squads to break down organizational data silos and resolve systemic reporting barriers across site networks
Community of Practice: Establish, champion, and mentor an Operations Quality Community of Practice for Quality AI & Data Insights. Elevate organizational digital fluency by coaching other team members on best practices

Who you are:

Required Skill Set & Competencies:

AI & Machine Learning Architecture: Strong hands-on engineering proficiency with enterprise data science environments (such as Dataiku or ML Studio). Advanced understanding of NLP, LLMs, and prompt engineering architectures
Developer & Execution Tooling: Strong proficiency in core programming for data data modeling (Python, SQL) and developer workflows (Git, Jira, Confluence, and script automation environments)
Agentic Framework Familiarity: Hands-on experience or deep conceptual understanding of custom agent architectures utilizing tools like the Claude Agent SDK or comparable enterprise-approved development kits
Data Systems Awareness: Solid structural knowledge of cloud data warehousing (Snowflake), pipeline concepts (AWS), and business intelligence delivery tools (ThoughtSpot, Tableau)

Background & Experience:

Education: Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. degree in Data Science, Informatics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related technical field
Professional Experience: 5-7+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning algorithms, complex data models, or automated software tools to support enterprise-level decision-making
Domain & Validation Knowledge: Experience working within a highly regulated manufacturing environment (such as Pharma, Diagnostics, or Medical Devices). Sound understanding of GxP compliance, US FDA 21 CFR Part 820 Quality Management System Regulations, and ISO 13485/9001 standards. Prior experience with Computerized System Validation (CSV) protocols is highly preferred
Strategic Matrix Leadership: Proven capability acting as a principal technical leader, driving global cross-functional projects, and aligning stakeholder expectations with a team-first, agile mindset

What we offer
:

Contract Details: Employment via an external recruitment agency for a period of 18 months (Zatrudnienie przez zewnętrzną agencję na okres 18 miesięcy)
Compensation Range: 228,900.00 PLN – 425,100.00 PLN gross annually (depending on experience and seniority level)
Impact & Exposure: Direct exposure to enterprise-scale AI architecture, global cross-functional leadership, and cutting-edge digital health technology in a highly innovative environment
Work Model: Flexible hybrid working model with modern office space in Warsaw

Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche IT first-hand? Check out our blog!

https://careers.roche.com/global/en/we-are-roche

jobs.title: Senior Windows Endpoint Developer (Workforce AI Security)
jobs.description:
The Role

The Windows agent runs on hundreds of thousands of enterprise machines, enforcing data-loss policies and providing visibility over employee AI usage. The hard part isn’t standard application logic — it’s building deep systems-level software, privileged services, and network interception mechanisms that execute reliably across highly heterogeneous enterprise environments without breaking host operations. The role owns the Windows agent end-to-end, serving as the technical authority for the platform while engineering silent installation and updates, certificate trust and TLS interception, system proxy configuration, and seamless coexistence with third-party security software.

About The Product

The platform provides enterprise-wide visibility and governance over employee interactions with generative AI tools and developer environments. Operating at global enterprise scale, it monitors endpoint AI usage, enforces real-time DLP policies, and inspects network traffic directly on managed devices. The Windows agent must operate reliably across highly varied corporate environments, alongside existing antivirus, EDR, VPN, proxy, and device-management software, without disrupting users or corporate connectivity.

Technology Stack

The core endpoint architecture is built primarily in C# and C++, with Python and PowerShell powering tooling and automation. The Windows platform includes privileged Windows services, registry, COM, WMI, UAC and elevation, WinHTTP and WinInet, certificate stores, system proxy configuration, and browser integrations for Edge and Chrome. Network-level interception and inspection may involve Windows Filtering Platform and related system components. Shared cross-platform logic increasingly relies on Python and Rust.

Deployment and field execution are managed through enterprise tooling such as Intune, Configuration Manager, Group Policy, and Tanium. The engineering toolkit includes Visual Studio, MSI and InstallShield, WiX, signtool, WinDbg, Process Monitor, Process Explorer, Wireshark, Git, and GitHub Actions.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own the Windows agent end-to-end, leading architecture for privileged services, inter-process communication, installation, and unattended auto-update pipelines
Architect certificate trust and TLS interception on Windows, including correct handling of machine and user certificate stores, trust chains, and applications that resist interception
Design resilient state-reconciliation logic for system proxy configuration, including coexistence with VPN clients, cloud proxies, and other software competing for proxy state
Build deep integrations into AI developer tools such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code to inspect and govern local AI activity
Ensure reliable coexistence with antivirus, EDR, VPN, proxy, and other endpoint security products, fixing compatibility issues in the product rather than relying on customer-side exclusions
Drive field root-cause engineering, using logs, diagnostics, and evidence from real customer environments to turn recurring deployment and runtime failures into permanent product fixes
Own the Windows installation and update experience, including silent installation, upgrades, rollback scenarios, and enterprise deployment edge cases
Act as the definitive Windows technical owner, establishing engineering standards, conducting code reviews, and contributing to the technical direction of the agent
Help ensure the product follows a fail-open philosophy, with every error path designed to degrade gracefully rather than interrupt customer connectivity or access to corporate resources

What We Expect

Must-have

8+ years of systems-level development experience preferred, including strong production experience building Windows software or endpoint products. 5+ years may be considered for candidates with a strong security background
Deep, practical expertise in Windows internals and architecture — this is critical. The role requires someone who understands Windows at the system level, not just someone who has built applications for Windows
Professional-level C# proficiency is mandatory and will be the primary development language, with strong C++ systems experience
Proven production experience developing Windows software, endpoint agents, or security products
Deep foundational knowledge of Windows security architecture, including privileged services, registry, COM, WMI, UAC, elevation, and certificate management
Proven track record of owning endpoint features end-to-end, from technical decisions and architecture through implementation and production delivery
Ability to work independently and debug complex field issues without constant guidance or direct access to customer machines
Strong communication and collaboration skills, especially in a remote and cross-functional environment
CS degree or equivalent practical engineering background

Nice-to-have

In-depth expertise with Windows installer technologies such as MSI, InstallShield, or WiX, including custom actions, transforms, silent installation, upgrades, and rollback scenarios
Hands-on experience with enterprise deployment tooling such as Intune, Configuration Manager/SCCM, Group Policy, or Tanium
Experience troubleshooting antivirus and EDR coexistence, including understanding which endpoint behaviors and installer patterns commonly trigger security products
Strong knowledge of Windows certificate stores and code signing, including machine versus user stores, EV signing, and SmartScreen reputation
Production experience with TLS interception, trust-chain management, certificate pinning, and related edge cases
Experience with Windows Filtering Platform, network drivers, or kernel-mode components
Python or Rust experience
Hands-on experience with AI developer tooling such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code extensions, or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Browser extension development for Edge or Chrome
Network traffic inspection or packet analysis experience
Previous experience at a cybersecurity vendor, particularly with DLP, CASB, EDR, or browser security products
macOS or cross-platform endpoint development experience

How The Team Works

Fail open, always. Nothing shipped may prevent a customer from browsing the internet or reaching corporate resources. Every error path should degrade gracefully
Fix the product, not the customer. When the agent conflicts with another vendor’s software, the engineering team owns the fix rather than asking the customer to add an exclusion
Read the logs before theorizing. Diagnosis starts with evidence from the actual machine, not assumptions
Tests are how the team ships confidently into environments it cannot log into. Reproducibility, diagnostics, and automated testing are essential to the development process

Team & Growth

You would join a small Windows-focused team with significant room to grow.
The current core team has two Windows developers and one macOS developer, with a plan to hire several additional Windows engineers.
The role itself is expected to remain focused on Windows development for at least the next 6–12 months, with the opportunity to have significant ownership as the team grows.

The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. jobs.title: .NET-utvecklare till riskbedömning
jobs.description:
Att jobba som . NET utvecklare

Vill du utveckla moderna försäkringslösningar och samtidigt få möjlighet att påverka både teknik och arbetssätt?

Hos oss blir du en del av ett erfaret team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och dialog är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du får arbeta nära verksamheten och användarna, vilket ger dig snabb återkoppling på det du utvecklar och möjlighet att se hur dina lösningar används i praktiken.

Här får du dessutom vara med i en spännande teknisk förflyttning. Vi har lanserat den första versionen av vårt nya riskbedömningssystem och fortsätter nu utvecklingen samtidigt som äldre lösningar successivt ersätts.

Därför kan det här vara jobbet för dig:

Du får kombinera nyutveckling och förvaltning och följa lösningar hela vägen från kod till produktion.
Du arbetar med verksamhetskritiska lösningar som bland annat används för digital hälsodeklaration och medicinsk riskbedömning.
Du får arbeta i ett erfaret team med nära samarbete och frekvent feedback från verksamheten.
Du får möjlighet att bredda din kompetens mellan .NET och React, oavsett om din tyngdpunkt idag ligger inom backend eller frontend.
Du har flera möjliga utvecklingsvägar framåt, exempelvis mot systemansvar, Scrum Master eller mjukvaruarkitektur.

Som .NET-utvecklare arbetar du med utveckling och förvaltning av applikationerna i teamets portfölj. En viktig del är vår digitala hälsodeklaration och vårt riskbedömningssystem med regelmotor och handläggarstöd. Rollen innebär att du successivt bygger upp förståelse för helheten och tar ansvar för lösningarna även efter att de gått i produktion.

Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Är Att

utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar i .NET och React
arbeta med felsökning, incidenthantering och förvaltning
testa din egen kod och delta aktivt i code reviews
hantera release och deploy samt arbeta med Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
arbeta med SQL, integrationer och teamets olika applikationer
samarbeta med bland annat riskbedömare, processägare och andra utvecklingsteam
bidra med idéer, feedback och problemlösning tillsammans med dina kollegor.

Vi är 8 personer i teamet som består av bland annat utvecklare, testare, Product Owner, Scrum Master och mjukvaruarkitekt. Vi utgår från vårt huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm och arbetar hybrid, med en kombination av arbete på kontoret och på distans. Du rapporterar till gruppchef IT inom IT Risk & Hälsa.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig med omkring fem års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och som relativt snabbt kan bidra i teamets leveranser. Du har erfarenhet av .NET-utveckling och gärna React, men det viktiga är att du är nyfiken på helheten och vill utvecklas över gränserna mellan frontend och backend.

Du behöver kunna kommunicera väl på svenska i tal och skrift. Kunskaper inom SQL, Azure DevOps, CI/CD och releasehantering eller motsvarande är värdefulla eftersom du arbetar med hela utvecklingskedjan. Erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen är meriterande.

Som person är du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och problemlösningsorienterad med förmåga att självständigt planera ditt arbete. Du söker orsaken när problem uppstår och tar dem vidare till en lösning, vilket är viktigt i arbetet med nyutveckling, förvaltning, felsökning och incidenthantering.

Samarbete och kommunikation är en naturlig del av rollen. Du delar kunskap, lyfter frågor och kan ge och ta emot feedback på ett konstruktivt sätt. Vi uppskattar också din nyfikenhet och vilja att sätta dig in i nya områden och förstå helheten.

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef (namn på chefen) på (mailadress).

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med rekryterande chef Patric Wu via patric.wu@skandia.se eller Talent Acquisition Partner på madelene.skogh@skandia.se.

Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Är Att

utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar i .NET och React
arbeta med felsökning, incidenthantering och förvaltning
testa din egen kod och delta aktivt i code reviews
hantera release och deploy samt arbeta med Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
arbeta med SQL, integrationer och teamets olika applikationer
samarbeta med bland annat riskbedömare, processägare och andra utvecklingsteam
bidra med idéer, feedback och problemlösning tillsammans med dina kollegor.

Vi är 8 personer i teamet som består av bland annat utvecklare, testare, Product Owner, Scrum Master och mjukvaruarkitekt. Vi utgår från vårt huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm och arbetar hybrid, med en kombination av arbete på kontoret och på distans. Du rapporterar till gruppchef IT inom IT Risk & Hälsa.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig med omkring fem års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och som relativt snabbt kan bidra i teamets leveranser. Du har erfarenhet av .NET-utveckling och gärna React, men det viktiga är att du är nyfiken på helheten och vill utvecklas över gränserna mellan frontend och backend.

Du behöver kunna kommunicera väl på svenska i tal och skrift. Kunskaper inom SQL, Azure DevOps, CI/CD och releasehantering eller motsvarande är värdefulla eftersom du arbetar med hela utvecklingskedjan. Erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen är meriterande.

Som person är du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och problemlösningsorienterad med förmåga att självständigt planera ditt arbete. Du söker orsaken när problem uppstår och tar dem vidare till en lösning, vilket är viktigt i arbetet med nyutveckling, förvaltning, felsökning och incidenthantering.

Samarbete och kommunikation är en naturlig del av rollen. Du delar kunskap, lyfter frågor och kan ge och ta emot feedback på ett konstruktivt sätt. Vi uppskattar också din nyfikenhet och vilja att sätta dig in i nya områden och förstå helheten.

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef (namn på chefen) på (mailadress).

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med rekryterande chef Patric Wu via patric.wu@skandia.se eller Talent Acquisition Partner på madelene.skogh@skandia.se.

Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

jobs.title: Senior Developer till Insrt – en del av If
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och skapa framtidens försäkringslösningar? Hos Insrt får du möjlighet att bygga en ny teknisk plattform från grunden, arbeta nära affären och påverka både produktutveckling och tekniska vägval – i ett sammanhang där dina idéer verkligen gör skillnad.

Om företaget

Insrt är ett nytt och strategiskt initiativ inom If – ett av Nordens ledande försäkringsbolag. I rollen blir du anställd hos If, men arbetar dedikerat inom Insrt, där fokus ligger på att utveckla digitala, embedded och gränsöverskridande försäkringslösningar. Genom att bygga försäkring direkt in i andra produkter, tjänster och affärsflöden skapar Insrt moderna lösningar som är enkla, relevanta och sömlöst integrerade i människors vardag. Med en modern och skalbar teknikplattform samt en snabbt växande produktportfölj utmanar Insrt traditionella sätt att tänka försäkring – med användarupplevelse, innovation och affärsnytta i centrum.

Hos Insrt blir du en del av ett nyetablerat och tvärfunktionellt team där utvecklare, produktägare och specialister samarbetar tätt mellan teknik och affär. Miljön präglas av nyfikenhet, högt engagemang och en gemensam ambition att bygga lösningar som verkligen gör skillnad. Här finns ett starkt mandat att testa nytt, fatta snabba beslut och kontinuerligt förbättra både produkter och arbetssätt. Här får du entreprenörsandan och tempot från en scaleup, kombinerat med tryggheten, stabiliteten och de långsiktiga resurserna som följer med att vara en del av If.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som Senior Developer får du en nyckelroll i att designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla Insrts tekniska plattform. Du arbetar främst med backendutveckling i C#/.NET och Azure, men har även möjlighet att bidra i frontend vid behov.

Rollen innebär ett stort tekniskt ägandeskap med möjlighet att påverka arkitektur, tekniska vägval och utvecklingsprocesser. Du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt, med ansvar för att bidra till den tekniska riktningen samtidigt som du är hands-on i utvecklingen och bygger lösningar med hög kvalitet.

Du arbetar med API-baserad utveckling, integrationer och nyutveckling av plattformskomponenter, samtidigt som du bidrar till att förbättra befintliga flöden och lösningar. Du samarbetar nära andra utvecklare, produktägare och intressenter och deltar aktivt i arkitekturdiskussioner.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:
Utveckla och underhålla API:er och backendlösningar i C#/.NET
Designa och bygga skalbara lösningar i Azure
Driva arkitekturdiskussioner och tekniska vägval
Arbeta nära produkt och andra team för att skapa affärsvärde
Bidra till förbättrade arbetssätt, kodkvalitet och utvecklingsprocesser

Utbildning, erfarenhet och personliga egenskaper

Flerårig erfarenhet av utveckling i C# och .NET
Erfarenhet av molnbaserade lösningar, gärna i Azure
Erfarenhet av API-baserad arkitektur och integrationslösningar
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift
Relevant högskoleutbildning inom exempelvis datateknik, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande erfarenhet

Det är även meriterande om du har:
Erfarenhet från reglerade verksamheter, såsom finans eller försäkring
Erfarenhet från produktbolag eller startup-miljöer
Frontendkompetens, exempelvis inom Blazor eller liknande ramverk
Erfarenhet av AI-stödd utveckling, såsom GitHub Copilot eller Microsoft Copilot, samt intresse för detta

Vi söker dig som trivs i en miljö där du får ta stort ansvar och vara med och påverka. Du är lösningsorienterad och pragmatisk, med förmåga att omsätta komplexa problem till tydliga och värdeskapande lösningar.

Du uppskattar samarbete och kunskapsdelning, samtidigt som du är självgående och trygg i att driva ditt arbete framåt. Med ett helhetsperspektiv på system och arkitektur bidrar du till att skapa hållbara och skalbara lösningar över tid.

När löven skiftar färg och luften blir krispigare, är det ett perfekt tillfälle att blicka framåt – mot ny teknik, spännande utmaningar och nästa steg i karriären. På HiQ vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med erfarna backendutvecklare som är nyfikna på framtida möjligheter i rollen som konsult tillsammans med oss. 🍂

Vi är övertygade om att teknik ska vara rolig, enkel och mänsklig. På HiQ kombinerar vi spetskompetens inom IT med en kultur där det finns plats för nyfikenhet, samarbete och lekfullhet. Här får du bidra med din expertis och utvecklas tillsammans med kollegor som brinner för att skapa verkligt värde med hjälp av modern teknik och robusta backendlösningar.

Så här kan du bidra

Beroende på din profil och kommande uppdrag kan du få arbeta med att skapa och förvalta robusta, skalbara och säkra backendlösningar inom olika branscher – från fordon och medtech till offentlig sektor och finans. Det kan exempelvis handla om att bygga helt nya plattformar från grunden eller att vidareutveckla och optimera befintliga system. Du arbetar nära kollegor inom bland annat arkitektur, frontend, test och UX för att skapa välfungerande helhetslösningar. Du får även möjlighet att utforska olika branscher och tekniker, delta i tekniska diskussioner samt dela med dig av din kunskap och inspirera andra.

Vi letar efter dig som…

Har minst 7 års relevant erfarenhet inom backendutveckling.
Har erfarenhet av C# och ramverk eller tekniker som .NET, ASP .NET eller .NET Core.
Har erfarenhet av C++ och Linux.
Har erfarenhet av Python eller Golang samt ramverk som Django eller Flask.
Har erfarenhet av molnplattformar som Azure, AWS eller GCP.
Har relevant akademisk utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
Behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Vi ser positivt på erfarenhet av att utveckla skalbara, säkra och hållbara system, liksom kunskap inom arkitektur, testning och moderna utvecklingsmetoder. Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad, flexibel och kommunikativ. Du uppskattar gemenskapen i ett team, men kan också ta egna initiativ och driva ditt arbete framåt.

Varför HiQ?

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med varierande uppdrag hos några av regionens mest intressanta kunder. Vi satsar på kompetensutveckling genom utbildningar, certifieringar och intern kunskapsdelning – och erbjuder en kultur där vi stöttar varandra, firar framgångar och har riktigt roligt längs vägen. Tillsammans bygger vi det bolag vi själva vill arbeta på! 🥳

Nyfiken på framtida möjligheter?

I Syd har vi kontor i Malmö, Helsingborg och Karlskrona. Vi vill gärna komma i kontakt med dig som är nyfiken på HiQ och öppen för nya utmaningar. Genom att lära känna dig, din kompetens och dina drivkrafter kan vi tillsammans hitta ett sammanhang där du kan utvecklas och göra skillnad.

👉 Skicka in din ansökan och berätta mer om dig själv. När din kompetens möter rätt uppdrag kan det bli starten på något riktigt bra!

Sist men inte minst!

Vi välkomnar ansökningar från alla – oavsett ålder, könsidentitet eller uttryck, livserfarenhet och bakgrund. Vi tror att mångfald skapar nytänkande och bidrar med fler perspektiv. Hoppas vi hörs i höst!

jobs.title: .Net Architect
jobs.description:
Experience & Qualifications

• 13+ years in software engineering, with strong enterprise .NET design and delivery experience.
• Proven track record as solution, application or technical architect on complex programmes.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or IT, or equivalent experience.
• Relevant platform, cloud, architecture or DevOps certifications advantageous, not mandatory.

Key Deliverables & Success Measures

• Approved, traceable, implementation-ready architecture and design artifacts.
• Documented decisions, standards, risks, assumptions and mitigations.
• Solutions meeting agreed security, performance, reliability and operational readiness.
• Reduced technical risk via early validation, reusable patterns and automation.
• Timely resolution of blockers; improved engineering consistency and code quality.

Role Purpose

Provide end-to-end technical leadership for enterprise solutions on the .NET platform: translating business and non-functional requirements into scalable, secure and resilient architectures, and guiding engineering teams through implementation, modernization and operational readiness.
Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

• Own high-level and detailed architecture for complex .NET applications, APIs, integrations and modernization initiatives.
• Convert functional and non-functional requirements into blueprints, component designs, interface contracts and implementation guidance.
• Select appropriate architecture patterns and assess trade-offs across scalability, performance, security, cost and maintainability.
• Ensure alignment with enterprise standards, approved platforms, reusable patterns and target-state roadmaps.
Technical Leadership & Governance

• Give hands-on architectural direction to development, QA, DevOps, security and support teams.
• Set coding, API, integration, logging, configuration, testing and deployment standards.
• Run architecture reviews, design walkthroughs, technical risk assessments and PoC evaluations.
Security, Reliability & Performance

• Embed secure-by-design across identity, authorization, secrets, data protection and interface security.
• Define resiliency patterns — retry, timeout, failover, HA and DR — plus performance and capacity targets.
• Ensure observability through structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards and alerting.
Stakeholder Engagement

• Facilitate technical discovery with business, product, security, infrastructure and vendor stakeholders.
• Communicate complex decisions clearly to engineering and leadership audiences.
• Maintain architecture artifacts, decision records, risk logs and technical roadmaps.

jobs.title: Process Integration Specialist
jobs.description:
About the role

Are you passionate about process improvement, automation, and connecting business needs with technology? Do you enjoy understanding how things work end-to-end, challenging inefficient ways of working, and turning ideas into practical digital solutions?
We are looking for a Process Integration Specialist to join our team and help drive business efficiency, data quality, and automation across our Nordic service and administrative processes.
In this role, you will work at the intersection of business and technology, helping our organisation move from manual and fragmented ways of working towards connected, scalable, and transparent processes.
In this role, you will work at the intersection of business and technology, helping our organisation move from manual and fragmented ways of working towards connected, scalable, and transparent processes.
As a Process Integration Specialist, you will help analyse business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and design and implement automation and integrations that create measurable value.
A key goal of your work will be reducing duplicate work, improving data quality, increasing transparency, and making processes easier to manage and scale.
You will work closely with business stakeholders, IT, and global automation teams. Your ability to understand both business challenges and technical possibilities will be essential in turning requirements into robust solutions.
We believe technology should support people, reduce repetitive work, and augment human decision-making. You will therefore play an important role in making sure our automation solutions are practical, reliable, and user-focused.
What you will be doing

Analyse and describe end-to-end and sub-processes across service, finance, order-to-cash, logistics, and support functions.
Identify opportunities to simplify, optimise, standardise, and automate processes.
Design, build, and maintain automated workflows and integrations using Microsoft Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Azure Logic Apps, SharePoint Agents, and related Microsoft technologies.
Translate business needs into clear functional and technical specifications, including data structures (XML/JSON), interfaces and exception handling.
Create and maintain high-quality documentation covering process designs, automation logic, integrations, and operational procedures.
Act as a bridge between business stakeholders, IT, and global automation teams, ensuring solutions align with architecture, security, and governance requirements.
Support integrations with external systems and business partners, including procurement and ordering technologies such as cXML, OCI, and Peppol.
Proactively challenge manual, repetitive, and error-prone ways of working and contribute to a continuous improvement and automation mindset across the organisation.
Help ensure that automation delivers tangible business value while maintaining quality, compliance, and a positive user experience.

You will ideally have

We are looking for someone with a curious mindset and a strong desire to learn and improve. You understand business needs, think analytically, and have a genuine interest in technology and how it can create value.
You have:
Proven experience in process optimisation, automation, process integration, or a similar role, ideally within a B2B service or operations environment.
Strong knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem, particularly Power Automate, Power Automate Desktop, Copilot Studio, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and SharePoint Agents.
Good understanding of data formats and integration concepts, including XML, JSON, APIs, and REST principles.
Experience analysing and improving business processes and workflows.
A basic understanding of procurement and order integration standards such as cXML, OCI, and Peppol.
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
The ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent documentation skills and a strong focus on quality.
The ability to navigate complex organisational structures, governance models, and stakeholder environments.
Experience working with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
A natural curiosity and a mindset of continuously asking: “Is there a better way to do this?”
The ability to influence, guide, and challenge stakeholders without relying on formal management authority.
A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field is an advantage. Equivalent professional experience is also highly relevant.

Who will thrive in this role?

You are someone who is naturally curious, structured, and pragmatic. You enjoy digging into a process to understand what is really happening, not just what the process documentation says.
You can move comfortably between a conversation with a business user about a frustrating manual task and a technical discussion about APIs, data structures, integrations, or automation architecture.
You don't just ask “Can we automate this?” You ask “Should we automate this, what value will it create, and what is the best way to do it?”
If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.
Apply now and help us build smarter, more connected ways of working.

In return for your commitment, you can expect

At Ricoh, work should feel meaningful, supportive and fulfilling. The Ricoh Promise shapes your experience through four pillars that bring our culture to life.

Love to Connect

You become part of a global community built on openness, inclusion and genuine collaboration.
Across teams, countries and roles, you'll find people who listen, involve and encourage you - helping you feel valued and able to be yourself every day.

Love to Grow

Your development truly matters to us. With access to learning pathways, mentoring and career opportunities across functions and countries, you'll be supported to stretch your skills, explore new directions and stay future-ready in a changing world.

Love to Give Back

Purpose is part of how we work. You'll have opportunities to make a difference through volunteering, sustainability initiatives and community programmes that reflect our shared values and commitment to positive impact.

Love to Succeed

Success at Ricoh is something we pursue together. You'll benefit from fair rewards, flexible working, wellbeing resources and real recognition - including programmes such as the Imagine. Change. Awards, where colleagues celebrate each other's achievements.
We are an equal opportunities employer

We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions are based on skills, experience and potential, and we are committed to creating a fair and inclusive recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment journey, please let us know and we will support you to bring your best self forward.
Ready to love what you do? Apply now and help us shape what comes next.

About Ricoh

A global leader in digital services, recognised for innovation, sustainability and a people-first culture. We feature in the Gartner Magic Quadrant
, are listed in the Global 100 Most Sustainable Companies
, and have been named one of Forbes’ World’s Best Employers 2025

jobs.title: AI Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Someone built an agent on their laptop. It works well enough that they use it every day. It also reads sensitive data and sends it to a model outside the company, and nobody in IT knows it is there.

Shadow AI like this is spreading fast. The usual reaction is to hunt these agents down and switch them off. We would rather make them possible.

Arc Theory builds the platform that makes that possible. We work with companies that want AI running in production, with the governance and security to hold up under audit. That means the agent runtime, how agents are operated and governed, and the road from an idea to something people can rely on. We are a small senior team in Stockholm, founded in 2026 by Björn Eriksen, who led solutions architect teams at Microsoft and AWS, and Marcus Falck, who founded a SaaS company and ran it as CTO for ten years. Arc Theory is backed by Zefyr Development, a venture developer that starts and scales specialist consultancies. We are now expanding the team.

What you would do

You would work with Swedish companies that have the ambition and the pilots, and nothing dependable in production yet. In one week you might sketch an architecture on a whiteboard, sit with a CIO, and then spend two days beside the client's own architects and developers building it.

A good part of the job is not technical. Organisations change when people change how they work, and someone has to bring the client's engineers with them.

What you bring

An ideal candidate is a senior solutions architect with years of hands-on cloud experience, building on Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, with real depth in at least one. With that comes an understanding of what an autonomous process can reach when nobody is watching, what the damage is when it gets something wrong, and how anyone would know its answers are good.

You also bring a working foundation in AI, enough to reason about how models and agents behave once they are in production. We are deliberately not listing frameworks here. We would rather meet people who arrived at this from different directions.

You do not need to have run AI agents in production. Almost nobody has yet. You want to be among the first who do.

Inside Arc Theory we work in English, so fluency in written and spoken English is a requirement. Swedish is a plus, as some client assignments might require it.

What makes you more interesting to us: a background in consulting, experience of security and governance, and what you learned taking something past the pilot stage.

Who we are looking for

This is the right job for someone who wants a say in what Arc Theory becomes. The first hires decide how the work is done here, and we would rather work that out with you than hand you a method. You would be the one who notices the pattern worth reusing on the next engagement. And good people tend to follow people they have worked with, so we would be glad if some of them followed you.

Pay

A fixed base salary, plus a variable part that grows with the hours you bill.

The total is yours to shape. You decide how it is paid out between salary, pension and benefits, and you can change that as your life changes.

Practical

Stockholm, hybrid. You decide where you work best, except when an engagement needs you at the client.

You need the right to work in Sweden without sponsorship, and to be in or willing to move to the Stockholm area at your own expense.

Apply here on LinkedIn, or write to me directly at bjorn.eriksen@arctheory.se. No cover letter needed. We start with a conversation. Questions before you apply are welcome at the same address.

Björn Eriksen, CEO, Arc Theory

We already have the recruitment support we need, so no agency pitches or ad sales, please.

Här omges du av kompetenta kollegor som utmanar varandra och håller sig i framkant. Du får stort eget ansvar och reell möjlighet att påverka arkitektur och arbetssätt – inte vänta på att någon annan ska fatta besluten. jobs.title: Software Engineer, License Client and Platform
jobs.description:
Most people have never heard of the technologies behind the products they use every day. Chances are, they've relied on ours.

Our software and development tools help build products used in cars, hospitals, factories, homes, and industries around the world. We help engineers solve complex challenges and create technology people can depend on.

Rooted in Nordic values and trusted by innovators worldwide, we combine deep technical expertise with a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and collaboration. With decades of engineering experience and a shared passion for technical excellence, we're helping shape the future of software and embedded development.

We take pride in building tools for people who build the world around us.

About the Role

IAR is part of Qt Group, operating as an independent business focused on embedded software development. We provide software development tools that help engineers develop, debug, test, and secure embedded software for products across automotive, industrial automation, medical technology, and other industries.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer for the team that owns IAR's license management platform. It’s the system that lets customers access and run IAR's software tools, whether through a cloud-based, subscription-ready platform or on-premises. The team works across the full stack, from the client software installed on developers' machines to the services and infrastructure behind it.

As a Software Engineer, you'll take ownership of the license client components used across IAR's product portfolio, while getting exposure to the wider platform and plenty of room to grow in the direction that interests you.

What You’ll Do

Develop and maintain the license client software used across IAR's products to access and validate licenses.
Support and evolve our cloud-based, subscription licensing platform alongside our on-premises offering.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the client and backend services, including occasional work in our license back-office systems.
Collaborate closely with the rest of the team on architecture, priorities, and technical decisions.
Get involved in wider platform work, including web services, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.

What You Bring to the Table

Professional experience in C++ software development.
Automation and scripting skills in Python or similar languages.
Experience building or integrating web services and APIs.
Comfortable working across both Windows and Linux environments.
Experience with containerized development using Docker.
Good communication skills in English.

Bonus Points For...

Exposure to cloud technologies (e.g. Azure), microservices, or Kubernetes
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, Git/GitLab, or Artifactory.
Experience with C# and/or Java, useful for our license back-office and integration services.

Build What Matters. Grow Where It Matters.

We believe work should support your life, not the other way around. That's why our benefits are designed to be flexible, inclusive, and meaningful across every stage of your journey. From wellbeing and growth to celebrating life's big (and small) moments, we invest in what matters to you, wherever you are.

Flexibility You Can Count On

We offer hybrid working options and flexible hours, empowering you to balance your personal life and professional goals because life outside of work matters, too.

Meaningful Wellbeing Support

From mental health resources to physical wellness programs, we provide practical, accessible support tailored to local needs.

Opportunities to Grow

Whether through hands-on learning, mentorship, or international collaboration, we invest in your development so your career can grow in the direction you choose.

Inclusive by Design

You'll join a team that values different perspectives, encourages collaboration, and creates space for everyone to contribute and succeed.

Rewarding Your Impact

Our compensation and benefits packages are competitive, regularly reviewed, and locally relevant, ensuring your contribution is recognized wherever you are.

Bring Your Whole Self

The best ideas come from people with different experiences, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, supported, and able to do their best work.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and provide equal opportunities for all. Our technology may be what we're known for, but it's our people who make the difference.

We'd love to learn more about you. Tell us about your skills and experience, but just as importantly, tell us what motivates you and what kind of impact you want to make.

jobs.title: Backend Developer till Karlskrona
jobs.description:
Backendutvecklare – dags att göra avtryck i höst!

När löven skiftar färg och luften blir krispigare, är det ett perfekt tillfälle att blicka framåt – mot ny teknik, spännande utmaningar och nästa steg i karriären. På HiQ vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med erfarna backendutvecklare som är nyfikna på framtida möjligheter i rollen som konsult tillsammans med oss. 🍂

Vi är övertygade om att teknik ska vara rolig, enkel och mänsklig. På HiQ kombinerar vi spetskompetens inom IT med en kultur där det finns plats för nyfikenhet, samarbete och lekfullhet. Här får du bidra med din expertis och utvecklas tillsammans med kollegor som brinner för att skapa verkligt värde med hjälp av modern teknik och robusta backendlösningar.

Så här kan du bidra

Beroende på din profil och kommande uppdrag kan du få arbeta med att skapa och förvalta robusta, skalbara och säkra backendlösningar inom olika branscher – från fordon och medtech till offentlig sektor och finans. Det kan exempelvis handla om att bygga helt nya plattformar från grunden eller att vidareutveckla och optimera befintliga system. Du arbetar nära kollegor inom bland annat arkitektur, frontend, test och UX för att skapa välfungerande helhetslösningar. Du får även möjlighet att utforska olika branscher och tekniker, delta i tekniska diskussioner samt dela med dig av din kunskap och inspirera andra.

Vi letar efter dig som…

Har minst 5 års relevant erfarenhet inom backendutveckling.
Har erfarenhet av Java och ramverk eller tekniker som Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate eller Kubernetes.
Har erfarenhet av Node.js, JavaScript eller TypeScript.
Har erfarenhet av C#, .NET, ASP.NET eller .NET Core.
Har erfarenhet av molnplattformar som Azure, AWS eller GCP.
Har relevant akademisk utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
Behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Vi ser positivt på erfarenhet av att utveckla skalbara, säkra och hållbara system, liksom kunskap inom arkitektur, testning och moderna utvecklingsmetoder. Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad, flexibel och kommunikativ. Du uppskattar gemenskapen i ett team, men kan också ta egna initiativ och driva ditt arbete framåt.

Varför HiQ?

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med varierande uppdrag hos några av regionens mest intressanta kunder. Vi satsar på kompetensutveckling genom utbildningar, certifieringar och intern kunskapsdelning – och erbjuder en kultur där vi stöttar varandra, firar framgångar och har riktigt roligt längs vägen. Tillsammans bygger vi det bolag vi själva vill arbeta på! 🥳

Nyfiken på framtida möjligheter?

I Syd har vi kontor i Malmö, Helsingborg och Karlskrona. Vi vill gärna komma i kontakt med dig som är nyfiken på HiQ och öppen för nya utmaningar. Genom att lära känna dig, din kompetens och dina drivkrafter kan vi tillsammans hitta ett sammanhang där du kan utvecklas och göra skillnad.

👉 Skicka in din ansökan och berätta mer om dig själv. När din kompetens möter rätt uppdrag kan det bli starten på något riktigt bra!

Sist men inte minst!

Vi välkomnar ansökningar från alla – oavsett ålder, könsidentitet eller uttryck, livserfarenhet och bakgrund. Vi tror att mångfald skapar nytänkande och bidrar med fler perspektiv. Hoppas vi hörs i höst!
