jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Architect to join our Architecture team. This is an opportunity to contribute to the design and architecture of our cloud-based platform using the latest technology advancements and methodologies. You will work closely with cross BU Engineering and Product teams to ensure implementation aligns with architectural designs to deliver enterprise solutions to our customers at scale. An appreciation for Technological risks and articulation of Non-functional requirements is required. Excellent communication and teamwork skills are expected alongside a strong work ethic and a can-do attitude.

You will have strong experience with the Microsoft Tech Stack and associated infrastructure and how it applies to DevOps and Security. You will have a keen interest in doing things the right way and for taking on new challenges.

While this role primarily involves Solution Architecture, it is expected that the candidate also has strong development skills and can help deliver on some core Platform offerings.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Microsoft technologies and familiarity with other Cloud Platform offerings. As a Software Architect, you will participate in architectural and key decision-making forums regarding choice of technologies, design approaches and Product roadmap. You will maintain a strong focus on the reliability, performance and security of our platform centred around a positive customer experience.

What You Will Do

Work with Product and Engineering Management to define the Product Roadmap and associated designs / technical enablers.
Facilitate implementation of a cloud-based platform that is secure, cost efficient, reliable, performant & scalable.
Define and maintain software architecture standards and best practices.
Lead the design and implementation of scalable and secure software solutions
Communicate NFR’s and designs effectively both formally and verbally.
Identify and help to reduce any Strategic Technical Debt.
Collaborate with development teams to ensure alignment with architectural goals and solution designs.
Evaluate and recommend tools, technologies, and processes to ensure the highest quality products for our platform.
Provide technical direction and mentoring to development teams.
Actively contribute to the development of core platform packages/template projects.
Keep abreast of the latest technological advancements that will help us to continuously improve our platform offering.
Partner with Architecture, DevOps and Platform Engineering teams to automate deployments, enforce governance, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements
Ensure data security, privacy, and compliance with all applicable policies and standards.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum of 8 years development experience.
3+ years of experience working in a Software, Technical or Solution Architecture role.
Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures and design patterns.
Exposure to design/build of reliable distributed enterprise systems capable of scaling to serve high volumes of traffic.
High attention to detail and willingness to take on complex technical challenges.
Proficiency in the Microsoft stack - .Net (c#), Web Api, Azure Services (inclu. Cosmos, Azure Sql, App Insights, Key Vault, AFD, etc.), Azure Devops, etc.
Familiarity with GCP offerings such as GKE, Postgres, and Cloud Functions.
Experience/Knowledge of JavaScript/Typescript Frameworks such as Angular and React.
Full understanding of the SDLC, with experience working with DDD, TDD, CI/CD.
Experience in Event Driven Architecture, Microservices, Kafka.
Exposure to Container Technology (Kubernetes, Docker, etc.)
Microsoft Azure / .Net certification an advantage.
Use of Co-Pilot/Other for AI design & coding efficiency gains.
A keen interest in AI technologies and tooling and how they can be leveraged by teams to accelerate Delivery and value to the business and our customers.
Intellectual curiosity and learning ability.
Excellent communication, documentation, design and stakeholder management skills.

Who We Are

Sustainability software specialist, AMCS, is headquartered in Ireland, with offices in Europe, the USA, and Australasia. With over 1,300 highly skilled employees across 22 countries, we specialize in delivering technology solutions to facilitate a carbon neutral future.

What We Do

Our innovative SaaS solutions increase efficiency and boost sustainability in resource-intensive industries. Over 5,000 customers across 23 countries already benefit from our Performance Sustainability software, ensuring we deliver practical solutions for improved profitability and environmental resilience across the globe.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Ecommerce
jobs.description:
About Phorest

Phorest is a growing tech company on a mission to help beauty businesses thrive. Our software empowers premium salons, spas, and aesthetic clinics around the globe with a suite of tools designed to enhance client experiences, streamline operations, and drive business growth. With a presence in the heart of the beauty industry, we are committed to fostering innovation, excellence, and community. At Phorest, we don’t just build software – we build success stories.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a new Engineering Manager to join our Ecommerce team within the Consumer Group. You will join a team who are responsible for building and maintaining Online Booking Platform as well as other consumer products such as online gift vouchers, branded applications and the online store where clients can sell their retail products conveniently. These products are built using technologies including React Native, Ruby & Java.

For this role, you will have the opportunity to be hands-on but instinctively focus on ensuring your team is set up for success first by removing any blockers. You will be a key member of this team, collaborating with the other engineers and facilitating the day-to-day running of the team. You will be responsible for growing, coaching and motivating a team of engineers to reach their own, and in turn Phorest’s goals. You will work closely with the Product Manager and Designer on the team to shape the strategy and also collaborate with other teams where there is a crossover of domains.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who wants a new challenge, where you’ll bring your experience to a supportive, growth mindset environment that will enable us to achieve our goals. You will join a multidisciplinary group of technology, product and design folks in building the future of the hair and beauty industry.

What You'll Do

Be responsible for leading the Ecommerce team within the Consumer domain of our product, including their overall health, productivity and impact.
Work with Engineering Managers, Product Leads and other key stakeholders to understand and shape the overarching consumer strategy.
Work with your team to ensure an appropriate balance of new capabilities and technical maintenance is being carried out within each development cycle so that the technical health of the platform is conserved as the platform evolves
Help identify bottlenecks within the team, improve working processes, and ensure software delivery best practices are being used to our advantage
Track the progress outwards to the wider teams, ensuring new capabilities are released on time and to the required quality standards
Champion the observability strategy within your team ensuring relevant service level objectives(SLOs) are set to measure and improve the e-commerce system’s reliability. Your team will have the correct monitoring tooling in place and proactively identify and address issues.
Drive a culture of quality within the team by establishing rigorous processes and methodologies. This will include maintaining high code quality standards, defining and implementing automated testing strategies and ensuring comprehensive test coverage for both new features and existing functionality.
There is going to be hands-on work here, as a leader of this team you are going to need to understand how things work, there will be times when you will need to contribute to the team's work, review code and support them in designing and building complex distributed systems. jobs.title: .NET utvikler
jobs.description:
Fra solid .NET-utvikling til praktisk AI: vil du være med fra starten?

Handelshøyskolen BI
er Norges største handelshøyskole og en selveid stiftelse med et tydelig samfunnsoppdrag. Vår forskning og utdanning bidrar til å løse samfunnets største utfordringer. Vi gir virksomheter kunnskapen de trenger for å lykkes, og mennesker muligheten til å bygge meningsfylte karrierer.

Endringstakten i samfunnet, teknologisk utvikling, KI, cybersikkerhet og nye forventninger fra studenter, spesielt etter pandemien krever en klar digital strategi. Derfor har vi de siste årene jobbet strategisk med å utvikle BI Digital som består av rundt 80 ansatte som er organisert i ulike produkt-team og som både bygger videre på markedsledende SaaS løsninger og egenutviklede og egenforvaltede løsninger.

Digitalavdelingen ved Handelshøyskolen BI utvikler tjenester som skaper en sømløs digital hverdag for våre 24 000 studenter, 1 000 ansatte og 300 000+alumni.

Nyopprettet initiativ og nyopprettede stillinger

BI har etablert en tverrfaglig AI Enabler Group (AEG) for å akselerere bruk av kunstig intelligens i hele organisasjonen. Vi samarbeider med forskningsmiljøer, undervisningsmiljøer og administrative avdelinger for å identifisere muligheter, gjennomføre pilotprosjekter og bidra til at vellykkede initiativer tas videre i organisasjonen. Målet er å bygge varig AI-kompetanse og styrke BIs evne til å ta i bruk kunstig intelligens på tvers av organisasjonen.

Vi skal nå rekruttere to hands-on og rådgivende utviklere med solid .NET erfaring og AI interesse til å bli med på denne spennende reisen sammen med oss.

Rollene

Som AI-utvikler vil du få en sentral rolle i BIs videre digitale utvikling. Du vil jobbe med å utforske, prototype og utvikle løsninger basert på generativ AI, LLM-er, RAG, søk, dokumentbehandling, integrasjoner og agentbaserte arbeidsflyter.

Du vil samarbeide tett med produktteam, arkitekter, utviklere og fagmiljøer for å forstå behov, teste hypoteser og bygge løsninger som kan tas videre fra idé til praktisk bruk. I rollen vil du også vurdere AI-verktøy og rammeverk opp mot BIs behov, arkitektur og krav til sikkerhet, personvern og etterlevelse, bidra til tekniske standarder og beste praksis, støtte overgangen fra eksperiment til produksjon og dele erfaringer på tvers av organisasjonen.

Du vil blant annet jobbe med

Microsoft Azure og Azure AI Foundry
Azure OpenAI og moderne språkmodeller
.NET/C# og API-utvikling
Designe og bygge løsninger basert på språkmodeller (LLM-er), RAG, agenter, søk, dokumentbehandling og automatisering
Integrasjoner mot BIs systemlandskap
CI/CD og moderne DevOps-praksis

Rollene er 100 % dedikert til AEG, men du vil samtidig være en del av Digital og inngå i et sterkt fagmiljø med utviklere, arkitekter og produktledere. Avhengig av initiativer og behov kan du også bidra i prioriterte utviklingsprosjekter utenfor de rene KI-løsningene.

Du vil også spille en viktig rolle i å bygge bro mellom eksperimentering og produksjon, og bidra til at vellykkede AI-initiativer kan skaleres og skape verdi i organisasjonen. For den rette kandidaten vil det være mulighet til å få et særskilt faglig lederansvar som Tech Lead eller lignende og bidra til å forme den tekniske retningen for AI-satsingen på BI.

Hvem er du?

Du er en utvikler med sterk teknisk forståelse, nysgjerrighet og evne til å lære raskt. Du trenger ikke nødvendigvis å ha jobbet lenge med AI, men du bør ha interesse for teknologien og helst ha testet ut AI-verktøy i utviklingsarbeid eller egne prosjekter. Du er initiativrik, selvdreven og trives med å samarbeide tett med både tekniske og ikke-tekniske miljøer.

Vi ser etter deg som har:

Solid erfaring med programvareutvikling innen .NET/C#, skyplattformer og integrasjoner
Erfaring med eller sterk interesse for generativ AI, språkmodeller, RAG, agenter eller tilsvarende AI-teknologier
Evne til å bygge prototyper, teste nye ideer og gjøre teknologi praktisk anvendbar
Erfaring med smidige utviklingsmetoder og tverrfaglige team
Høyere utdanning innen datateknologi, IT, informatikk eller tilsvarende
Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk

Vi er opptatt av å finne de rette menneskene. Det viktigste er ikke hvor lenge du har jobbet med AI, men at du har solid .NET utviklingskompetanse, lærelyst og evne til å omsette ny teknologi til løsninger som skaper verdi i praksis med spesielt fokus på AI. Du har faglig trygghet til å kvalitetssikre og videreutvikle løsninger som bygges med støtte fra AI. Du trives med komplekse problemstillinger, arbeider selvstendig og evner å kommunisere tekniske avveininger til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter.

Hva kan vi tilby?

Nyopprettede stillinger med stor påvirkningskraft hvor du kan være med å forme egen rolle
Muligheten til å være med på å bygge opp et nytt AI-miljø og påvirke hvordan kunstig intelligens tas i bruk ved en av Nordens ledende handelshøyskoler med stor innflytelse på fremtidens arbeidsliv
En solid og trygg arbeidsplass, i en virksomhet som investerer betydelig i digitale tjenester hvor du vil følge løsningene du er med på å skape over tid, og få tid til å fordype deg i våre produkter og en spennende sektor.
Du får dyktige fagfolk rundt deg å lære av, gode utviklingsmuligheter, deriblant kurs og muligheter for gratis videreutdanning.
Og ja, hos oss får du en fleksibel og familievennlig arbeidshverdag med fokus på balanse mellom jobb og privatliv, deriblant fri i romjulen og påskeuken i tillegg til fem ukers ferie.
Konkurransedyktige betingelser samt gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

Høres dette spennende ut?

Da håper vi du sender oss din CV i dag og noen ord om hvorfor du er interessert og passer.

Er du egentlig ikke på utkikk etter ny jobb, men ble nysgjerrig og vil vite mer, er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med vår rekrutteringspartner i Glasspaper People, Marianne Støen på telefon 920 35 260 og Thomas Schibbye på telefon 410 43 853.

Om Handelshøyskolen BI

Handelshøyskolen BI er en privat, uavhengig og internasjonalt akkreditert institusjon for forskning og høyere utdanning innenfor økonomi og ledelse. Med trippel akkreditering (EQUIS, AMBA, AACSB), en bred forskningsportefølje, 1.000 ansatte, 20.000 studenter og 300.000 alumni, er BI blant Europas ledende handelshøyskoler.

BIs Strategi 2030 har definert tydelige mål for å sikre at skolen leverer kunnskap som forandrer gjennom førsteklasses forskning og enestående læringsopplevelser. Dette gir virksomheter innsikt for å lykkes og enkeltpersoner muligheten til å bygge meningsfulle karrierer.
BIs hovedcampus ligger i Oslo, med tilleggscampuser i Bergen, Stavanger og Trondheim.

Vi søker en erfaren Software Engineer som vil være med å ta ansvar for betalingsløsninger og integrasjoner i systemet. Du jobber i kryssfunksjonelle team, tett på Product Manager, og får påvirke utvikling av produktet i et miljø med globale ambisjoner.

Teknologistacken vår inkluderer blant annet .NET/C#, MS SQL Server, React, Clojurescript og TypeScript. Hovedspråket for programmering er C#.

Kommer du fra et stort selskap og savner korte beslutningsveier? Hos oss er du tett på kunden, påvirker produktet og ser effekten av koden din - hver dag.

Dine hovedoppgaver

Designe, utvikle og drifte sikre betalingsflyter og API-integrasjoner mellom Xledger og banker/betalingsleverandører
Videreutvikle og nyutvikle funksjonalitet i ERP-systemet
Utvikle og vedlikeholde backend- og fullstack-løsninger med høy kvalitet
Sikre ytelse og robusthet gjennom testautomatisering og performance-forbedringer
Etterleve relevante standarder og regulatoriske krav (ISO 20022, PSD2), personvern og revisjonsspor
Samarbeide tett med Product Manager, DevOps og sikkerhet, samt veilede yngre utviklere

Vi ser etter deg som

Har 3-10 års erfaring med betalingsløsninger, gjerne innen bank og finans
Faglig sterk, og minimum bachelor innen informatikk eller tilsvarende
Behersker C#, .NET og SQL (T-SQL), og har solid erfaring med API- integrasjoner
Kjenner til/er nysgjerrig på regulatoriske rammeverk og standarder som PSD2 og ISO 20022
Er selvgående, samarbeidsorientert, ansvarlig og deler kunnskap – gjerne som mentor for andre
Kommuniserer godt på norsk og engelsk

Det er et pluss hvis du også har

Kjennskap til økonomi, regnskap eller lønn
Interesse for å jobbe med forretningskritiske systemer

Tilleggsinformasjon om teamet som jobber med betaling og integrasjoner

Teamet består av en Product Manager med solid domenekunnskap som har ansvar for spesifisering av behov og løsninger. I tillegg består teamet av to utviklere som er faglig dyktige, men fortsatt relativt tidlig i karrieren.
Det vil også være mulighet for å ta en Team Lead-rolle, ettersom nåværende Team Lead etter hvert skal videre til nye utfordringer. Rollen innebærer blant annet:
Ha oversikt over teamets arbeidsflyt: Prioriter oppgaver, vurder kompleksitet og sikre fremdrift.
Vurdere tekniske løsninger: Analysere om en oppgave kan løses, foreslå tilnærming og spesifikasjon.
Veilede og utvikle juniors: Bidra til faglig vekst, dele kunnskap og sikre høy kvalitet i leveranser.
Delta aktivt i utvikling og koding: Jobbe hands-on og sette standard for teamets tekniske arbeid.

Et miljø hvor du trives på jobb

Hos Xledger får du mer enn en spennende rolle. Du blir en del av et inspirerende teknologimiljø der utvikling, trivsel og samhold står i sentrum. Vi har faglig dyktige kolleger og et uformelt, hyggelig miljø der kunnskap deles og samarbeid verdsettes.
Vi legger stor vekt på sosiale aktiviteter og morsomme fellesopplevelser, alt fra Escape Room og Hemsedal-tur, til minigolf, bordtennisturnering, musikkbingo, strikkeklubb og buldreturer. Dette gir gode muligheter til å bli kjent på tvers av team og bygge et sterkt fellesskap.
Dette er en unik mulighet til å bruke kompetansen din på nye måter og sette spor i utviklingen av våre ERP-løsninger. Vi har gode onboardingsrutiner og sørger for at du får en solid start hos oss.
Klar for å søke?
Søk allerede i dag! Vi vurderer kandidater fortløpende. Lurer du på om rollen passer for deg? Kontakt Seniorrådgiver i Cruit, Stig Aulid Tlf 915 16 107 for en uforpliktende prat. Vi vet at ingen kandidater er like. Hvis du tror du kan bidra hos oss, hører vi gjerne fra deg!

Om selskapet

Xledger er ERP-systemet for ambisiøse selskaper som vil jobbe smartere, raskere og tryggere. En komplett, skybasert økonomiplattform klar til bruk. Få sanntidsinnsikt på tvers av selskaper og land. Skaler i takt med selskapets utvikling og la kunstig intelligens effektivisere prosesser i et system som alltid lærer.

Vi er et Software selskap som utvikler og leverer et av markedets mest avanserte skybaserte ERP-systemer. Hos oss får du en unik mulighet til å gjøre en konkret forskjell for tusenvis av brukere i over 60 land - ved å gjøre kompleks teknologi forståelig og tilgjengelig. Sammen bygger vi løsninger som forenkler hverdagen for økonomer, ledere og organisasjoner. Xledger er et av de mest funksjonsrike økonomisystemene i markedet (multi-tenant public cloud). Systemet utvikles kontinuerlig til det beste for brukerne.

Vi har kontorer i Norge, USA, England, Sverige, Finland og Danmark, og er ca. 300 ansatte globalt (ca. 180 befinner seg i Norge ved Oslo-kontoret).

Senior Azure Agentic AI Architect

Location: Oslo, Norway

About The Role

As a Senior Azure Agentic AI Architect, you will make an impact by designing and delivering cutting-edge, enterprise-grade Agentic AI solutions that push the boundaries of what's possible with Microsoft Azure. You will be a valued member of our AI & Emerging Technology practice, working collaboratively with cross-functional engineering teams, enterprise clients, and senior business stakeholders to transform bold AI ambitions into production-grade reality.

This is not a role for those who want to follow the playbook — it's a role for those who want to write it. If you thrive at the intersection of deep technical mastery and strategic innovation, and you're passionate about shaping the next generation of intelligent systems, we want to hear from you.

In This Role, You Will

Architect and implement enterprise-grade Agentic AI solutions on Microsoft Azure — leveraging Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure Machine Learning — with well-defined data flows, component architecture, and resource optimization that scale to meet real-world enterprise demands.
Engineer advanced LLM-powered applications and RAG pipelines using Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search, building retrieval-augmented generation systems that are efficient, grounded, and production-ready.
Design and deploy sophisticated multi-agent systems using Azure ecosystem tools such as Semantic Kernel and custom orchestration layers — enabling collaborative, goal-driven agent workflows across complex enterprise use cases.
Drive responsible AI governance and compliance by embedding Azure-native governance frameworks, Responsible AI principles, monitoring pipelines, model evaluation strategies, and security controls into every solution you deliver.
Lead stakeholder engagement and solution design sessions — translating complex AI architectures into clear, compelling narratives for business and technical audiences alike — and championing enterprise transformation through innovative AI strategy.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured — we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

Proven expertise in Microsoft Azure AI services — including hands-on experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure Machine Learning — and a strong portfolio of AI solutions delivered end-to-end, from prototyping through to production.
Deep knowledge of LLM engineering and RAG architectures, including the design and optimization of Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines integrated with Azure AI Search and other Azure-native data services.

Experience with Azure data platforms such as Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse, including the design of vector store integrations and scalable embedding and retrieval mechanisms using Azure AI Search vector capabilities.
A strong grasp of Responsible AI principles and practical experience implementing compliance controls, risk mitigation frameworks, and model governance in regulated enterprise environments.
Demonstrated ability to lead architecture discussions at the executive level — influencing technical strategy and helping clients navigate the complexities of enterprise AI transformation.
Familiarity with the latest developments in Agentic AI research, including autonomous planning patterns, tool-use frameworks, and emerging orchestration paradigms.

jobs.title: Chief Architect - TradeNet
jobs.description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

How we build

TradeNet is Singapore's National Single Window for trade permit processing. It handles over 9 million permit applications annually and accounts for around 10% of national tax revenues. We are replacing the decades-old legacy system with a modern, cloud-native platform.

The rebuild touches everything: decomposing a monolithic Java/J2EE application into cloud-native services, reconstructing undocumented business logic from incomplete legacy code, clearing compliance and data-governance constraints, and delivering a platform that multiple government agencies depend on daily.

The Chief Architect owns the technical coherence of this effort. You define how the system is structured, how teams interface with each other, and where the hard boundaries are. You work across product squads, TechOps, and programme leadership — but your authority is technical, not managerial.

Teams here use AI-assisted development workflows daily, including LLM/agentic-AI tooling for spec building, code generation, and test automation. You are expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with these tools.

[What you will be working on]

Architecture & technical direction

Set the overall system architecture for the TradeNet platform — service decomposition, data architecture, API contracts, infrastructure patterns.
Make binding technical decisions across teams. Resolve cross-squad technical disputes. Own the architecture decision record.
Design for resilience: fault isolation, blast-radius containment, defensive API contracts, and graceful degradation across a system that cannot go down.
Define the architectural guardrails, contracts, and patterns that teams build on — enabling independent delivery without architectural drift.

Legacy modernisation

Lead the technical strategy for decomposing and replacing the legacy monolith, including where to strangle, where to rewrite, and where to leave alone.
Reconstruct undocumented business logic from incomplete legacy codebases — using source analysis, documentation archaeology, dependency tracing, and AI-assisted reverse-engineering.
Navigate compliance and data-governance constraints that shape what can be migrated, how, and when.

Hands-on technical work

Write architecture documents, design specs, and technical RFCs that teams implement against.
Review code and designs across squads — particularly at integration boundaries and in foundational components.
Prototype and prove out critical technical approaches before committing teams to them.
Lead root-cause analysis on hard production and programme-level technical problems.

AI-assisted engineering

Pioneer and refine AI/LLM-assisted approaches to legacy analysis, code generation, test creation, and documentation.
Set the technical standards for how AI-generated output is evaluated, attributed, and held to quality.
Push the programme's use of agentic AI beyond basic code completion into architectural and analytical workflows.

Technical leadership

Earn trust with engineering teams through technical credibility — you lead by being right and being helpful, not by title. Your authority comes from the quality of your decisions and your willingness to get into the details.
Resolve technical disputes across squads. People will disagree on approach, and you are the one who makes the call and gets buy-in from both sides.
Balance technical debt against migration timelines. Know when to take a shortcut to hit a delivery date and when to say no because the long-term cost is too high. Make these tradeoffs explicitly and visibly.
Grow technical leads across squads. Mentor senior engineers. Raise the bar on technical decision-making across the programme.
Provide technical input to programme-level decisions: sequencing, risk, feasibility, and pivot recommendations.
Secure executive alignment on technical direction, particularly under ambiguity or when course corrections are needed.

[What we are looking for]

At least 12 years of hands-on software engineering, with significant time spent as a principal/staff engineer or architect on large-scale systems (not purely management track).
Experience as the overall technical lead across multiple teams (5+ teams, 40+ engineers) — setting architecture that others build on, without directly managing them.
Deep experience with legacy modernisation: decomposing monoliths, migrating off on-prem platforms, reconstructing business logic from incomplete or undocumented systems. You've done this before and know where it goes wrong.
Strong cloud-native architecture background — service design, event-driven systems, API-first platforms, infrastructure-as-code. Ideally on AWS.
Demonstrated ability to make hard technical calls under ambiguity — pivoting programmes, resolving cross-team disputes, and getting executive buy-in for technical direction when the path isn't clear.
Experience designing defensive/resilient architectures for systems that cannot afford downtime — fault isolation, contract enforcement, blast-radius containment.
Hands-on proficiency in a modern backend stack. The programme uses Kotlin, but deep experience in Java/JVM ecosystems, PostgreSQL, and cloud-native tooling is the important part.
Experience with AI/LLM-assisted engineering beyond basic code completion — reverse-engineering pipelines, agentic workflows, or AI-augmented analysis at the architectural level.
Strong written technical communication. Your architecture documents and RFCs need to stand on their own and be implementable by teams without further explanation.

Good to have

Experience in Singapore government technology ecosystem (GovTech, SGTS, IM8/CSA frameworks).
Background in trade, customs, regulatory, or financial platform engineering.
Prior engineering management experience (team lead, EM) — useful for mentoring and influence, though this is an IC role.
Experience with data-governance and compliance constraints that shape architecture (data residency, classification, audit trails).
Familiarity with the Java/J2EE legacy ecosystem you'd be migrating away from.

What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.   

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs. 

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you. 

Learn more about life inside GovTech at go.gov.sg/GovTechCareers.

Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech

We are seeking an AI Deployed Engineer (Agentic) to serve as a forward-deployed engineer on the agentic project team — partnering closely with the customer to build, deploy and operate agentic AI solutions end to end. In this hands-on role you will design and build full-stack systems and AI agents, writing production-grade code to take solutions from first prototype through to stable production, and then support Day 2 operations to keep the Azure platform underpinning the solution healthy, secure and cost-efficient. You will embed with customer teams to understand their needs and guide adoption, leverage SRE agents to automate routine operations, and codify working patterns into reusable tools and playbooks — all within a secure government environment.

Key Responsibilities

Build agentic solutions (software development): Design and build full-stack systems and AI agents, writing production-grade code that takes solutions from first prototype through to stable production.
Embed with the customer: Work closely with customer teams to understand their needs, scope work, sequence delivery, remove blockers early and guide adoption.
Own end-to-end delivery: Own technical delivery across deployments, making trade-offs between scope, speed and quality and adjusting plans to protect delivery.
Codify and share: Turn working solutions into reusable tools, playbooks and building blocks, and share field feedback that helps improve model and product performance.
Azure platform operations: Maintain the Azure platform and virtual machines (including the GitHub server).
Backup and resilience: Perform and verify GitHub server backups, using SRE agents to automate uptime checks and backups where possible.
DevOps and CI/CD: Operate and maintain GitHub Actions pipelines, validating that pipelines continue to work after upgrades.
Container platforms (ACA / ACR): Manage Azure Container Apps and clean up the Azure Container Registry.
App Services and Functions: Update and maintain frameworks for App Services and Function Apps.
Security operations: Pipe logs to Azure Monitor and Microsoft Sentinel, triage and close alerts, and monitor application performance via dashboards (working with developers to pipe crash logs and build dashboards).
• Identity and access (IAM): Review RBAC access for personnel and maintain least-privilege access.
• Cost and support: Produce cost reporting to the customer and monitor support tickets (service requests and issues) through to resolution.

Required Qualifications

Production-grade software development proficiency in Python, JavaScript or comparable stacks, with the ability to contribute directly in code.
Experience building or deploying systems powered by LLMs, agentic AI or generative-AI models.
Experience scoping and delivering complex systems in fast-moving or ambiguous environments, including customer-facing technical delivery.
Hands-on experience operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure platforms in production (Virtual Machines, App Services, Function Apps).
Experience with Azure Container Apps (ACA) and Azure Container Registry (ACR).
Strong DevOps / CI-CD experience, particularly GitHub Actions pipelines.
Experience with Azure Monitor and Microsoft Sentinel for logging, monitoring and security alert handling.
Working knowledge of IAM / RBAC and cloud security best practices.
Experience supporting Day 2 / run-and-maintain operations — patching, backups, incident and ticket handling — with an SRE mindset.
Ability to communicate clearly with engineers, product teams and customer stakeholders, with sound judgement under pressure.
Singapore Citizen who is eligible to obtain and maintain Singapore Government security clearance, and willing to undergo the required MINDEF vetting process.
Willingness to work on-site at client premises, including secured MINDEF facilities, as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with agentic AI solutions and using SRE agents to automate operational tasks.
Prior experience working within secured or classified government environments.
Microsoft certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400), Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500) or Security Operations Analyst (SC-200).
Experience with container platforms and cloud-native application deployment on Azure.

The opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI and agentic solutions, delivering and operating mission-critical systems for one of Singapore's most security-conscious public-sector clients. You will join a team that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and real-world impact.

As an experienced .NET Software Engineer, you will play a key role in driving the success of our Supply Chain Management (SCM) applications and the technical development and scaling of our core enterprise systems. Operating within a modern .NET ecosystem, you will actively contribute to the end-to-end software development lifecycle (SDLC), driving the design, enablement and implementation of high-performance product features. In this role, you will combine strong hands-on technical execution with team collaboration, helping to establish engineering best practices, designing robust APIs and ensuring overall software excellence.

Detailed Description

Full professional level; applies software engineering expertise in a specific area of specialization. Work is performed within established professional standards, technical guidelines and project objectives. Works on problems of moderate to diverse scope where analysis of technical requirements, system architectures and data schemas requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Exercises technical judgment within defined procedures and software development practices to determine appropriate action. Receives general instructions on routine development tasks and detailed instructions on new projects or complex system assignments. Builds productive collaborative relationships across development, QA and business analyst teams.

Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:

Contribute significantly to the architecture, design and end-to-end delivery of scalable enterprise web applications using ASP.NET Core MVC and .NET 10.
Play a key role in the new features enablement process, designing and building brand-new product capabilities from scratch to deliver strategic business value.
Establish robust architectural foundations, design RESTful APIs and optimize data flows integrated with Oracle DB.
Deliver clean, maintainable and scalable code by strictly adhering to SOLID principles and Clean Code practices.
Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement and retrospectives to ensure consistent sprint delivery and alignment.
Manage modern development workflows in GitLab, utilizing standardized branching strategies, merge request processes and CI/CD practices.
Collaborate closely with team members, sharing technical knowledge on modern .NET design patterns, coding standards and development best practices.
Ensure application reliability and stability by defining and implementing code testing standards, structured debugging and proactive performance optimization.
Proactively identify and resolve technical debt, modernize user interfaces and enhance application stability, security and performance.
Collaborate with IT/Business partners, cross-functional teams and stakeholders to translate business requirements into clear technical specifications.
Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectural designs, system configurations and database schemas to ensure long-term maintainability.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies

Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the .NET ecosystem, with a strong passion for modern C# features and ASP.NET Core.
Solid expertise in software design and architecture (Dependency Injection, Repository Pattern, Clean Architecture and Modular Design).
Advanced proficiency in Database Architecture and SQL, with experience optimizing Entity Framework Core integrated with Oracle DB (experience with other relational databases such as PostgreSQL or SQL Server is highly acceptable).
Competency in web development and frontend integration, combining ASP.NET Core MVC with JavaScript to build highly interactive, responsive and performant user interfaces using UI components (such as Telerik UI), along with basic HTML and CSS skills.
Hands-on experience with version control and modern Git workflows (GitLab, branch protection, Merge Requests) along with exposure to CI/CD automation pipelines.
Proven ability to work independently, take technical ownership of features, manage priorities and drive high quality standards through constructive code reviews.
Flexibility to occasionally participate in technical discussions, business requirements alignment and specifications review with managers, architects and stakeholders in the Canada timezone (EST).
Exceptional verbal and written English skills for cross-cultural collaboration, negotiating technical requirements and explaining complex .NET concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Self-driven, proactive mindset with a focus on writing highly scalable, long-term maintainable code and a desire to contribute to architectural discussions.
Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment with a solid understanding of sprint cycles, collaborative delivery and continuous improvement is preferred.
Understanding of Supply Chain Management (SCM) processes or ERP workflows is considered a strong asset (openness and willingness to learn these business processes is highly valued).
Knowledge or experience with UI frameworks (e.g., Telerik UI for ASP.NET Core with Ajax Binding, Tag Helpers) is a strong asset.
Prior knowledge of Java or Java ADF is not required, though any basic familiarity with these technologies is a welcome asset.
Openness to utilizing modern development tools and AI-assisted engineering practices is preferred.

Physical Demands

Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

Typical Experience

5+ years of experience in a similar role spanning software development and .NET web applications delivery.

Typical Education

University degree in one of the following: Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related technical field.

Notes

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

jobs.description:
Software Engineer

Despre noi

Suntem un start-up care sprijină SOLOprenorii în drumul lor spre succes. Peste 30.000 de freelanceri, medici, IT-iști și antreprenori români au ales în ultimii 5 ani să își gestioneze PFA-ul cu SOLO, și asta ne face și mai ambițioși. Vrem să ajungem cât mai curând la 100.000 de clienți activi. Misiunea noastră este să transformăm birocrația într-un sistem simplu, digital și automatizat.

Despre ce este rolul?

Construim un produs folosit deja de zeci de mii de oameni și vrem să-l ducem la următorul nivel.

Problema pe care o rezolvăm nu e simplă: legislație complicată, multe excepții și așteptări mari de la utilizatori.

Căutăm un engineer care vrea să contribuie la soluții reale și să crească într-un mediu cu impact direct în produs.

Misiunea ta în acest rol

Vei lucra pe probleme reale ale utilizatorilor noștri , unele bine definite, altele în curs de clarificare
Vei contribui la implementarea și îmbunătățirea sistemelor existente
Vei colabora cu echipa pentru a livra funcționalități în producție
Vei participa la decizii tehnice și vei învăța cum să le iei în timp
Vei folosi AI în workflow-ul tău pentru a crește viteza și calitatea

Ce ne dorim de la tine

2–4 ani experiență în dezvoltare software;
Experiență cu backend (ideal .NET Core, dar nu obligatoriu);
Experiență cu baze de date relaționale și modelare de date;
Capacitatea de a lucra pe probleme care nu sunt complet definite;
Interes pentru produs și modul în care este folosit de utilizatori;
Te folosești de AI (Cursor, Claude, Copilot sau similar) pentru a-ți îmbunătăți modul de lucru și înveți să validezi output-ul.

Ce oferim

Salariu competitiv (în funcție de nivel);
Zile nelimitate de concediu (pe care le și folosim);
Program flexibil;
Abonament premium la clinicile medicale Regina Maria;
Abonament Bookster;
Acces la tool-uri AI (Claude, Cursor, Copilot etc.) și buget de utilizare;
Lucrăm hibrid din București. Poți lucra până la 2 zile pe săptămână de acasă. În perioada de probă, te așteptăm zilnic la birou: e cea mai rapidă cale să înțelegi contextul, să cunoști echipa, și să ajungi să livrezi pe cont propriu.

Despre cum lucrăm în general

Modul În Care Lucrăm Este Influențat De Valorile În Care Credem Și Pe Care Ne Propunem Să Le Aplicăm În Tot Ce Facem

Creșterea continuă și accelerată e ceva fundamental - ne așteptăm de la fiecare coleg să își dorească să se dezvolte și să profite pe deplin de toate resursele pe care le punem la dispoziție pentru învățare. Apoi, ne așteptăm ca fiecare coleg să fie interesat mai ales de rezultat, nu doar de efort în sine.
Clientul este în centrul activității noastre: îi înțelegem nevoia reală, îl tratăm cu empatie și alegem soluții simple și clare pentru el. Facem toate acestea în timp ce ne comportăm cu bunăvoință unii față de alții, oferim și acceptăm feedback și menținem și consolidăm un spirit de echipă în care să ne regăsim cu toții.
Fiind un start-up, ne dorim alături oameni energici, curajosi, autonomi, cu o gândire dincolo de tipare, cu simțul umorului și cu o mare flexibilitate mentală, pentru că adesea realitatea din jur și activitățile noastre de zi cu zi se schimbă din mers în timp ce direcția rămâne clară: suntem aici pentru a sprijini SOLOprenorii.

Teciem designs, builds, and delivers treasury and capital markets software solutions for financial institutions worldwide. We serve banks of every size and geography, offering the right setup for the right need.
Our solutions are designed to replace multiple disconnected systems with one complete, front-to-back platform, helping customers to capture trading and business opportunities quickly, clearly and with control. We cover the entire trading lifecycle, ensuring that everything - from execution to position keeping, to risk management – runs smoothly.
With decades of experience and one of the largest, most diverse client bases in the industry, we turn deep industry knowledge into software that covers most asset classes, meets complex real-world treasury and capital market's needs, and adapts as markets evolve.

Summary

The Senior Software Engineer
designs, develops, analyzes, and maintains high-quality software applications for the Summit
project. This role involves participating in the full software development lifecycle, collaborating with stakeholders, resolving complex technical issues, and contributing to the delivery of reliable and scalable software solutions.

Responsibilities & Deliverables:

Your deliverables as a Senior Software Engineer
will include, but are not limited to, the following:
Participates in software design meetings and analyzes user needs to determine technical requirements.
Designs and develops high-quality code.
Tests, debugs, analyzes and fixes application problems/issues. Works closely with stakeholders to fix issues in a timely fashion.
Follows the software development lifecycle process.
Interact with internal stakeholders to support product releases and/or resolve program problems.
Other duties and projects as assigned.

Required Experience:

5+ years of software development experience, including software design and development.
Experience with C++
and C#
.
Familiarity with RESTful APIs
, SQL
, and JSON/XML
.
Experience with version control systems (ex: Git
)
Knowledge of software development methodologies and the software development lifecycle ( SDLC
).
Strong technical, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently provide solutions to technical problems of moderate scope and complexity.
Effective verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

Experience with scripting and automation tools ( PowerShell, Bash, Python
)
Experience with multithreading, concurrency and thread-safe design
Financial services
or capital markets
industry experience.

How We Work

Flexible hybrid

Diverse Minds, Shared Ambition

At Teciem, we believe that our strength comes from the diversity of our people. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our innovation and help us build solutions that truly make a difference in the world of financial technology.
We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, heard, and empowered to grow. Here, you can bring your whole self to work, contribute your unique ideas, and be part of a team driven by shared ambition.
We welcome talent from all walks of life and encourage applications from individuals of all genders, races, ages, abilities, identities, and beliefs. Together, we’re shaping a culture where diversity isn’t just celebrated — it’s essential to our success.

Responsible for defining and driving the end-to-end architecture of projects delivered within the Core & Integrations vertical, translating business and non-functional requirements into scalable, resilient, and maintainable solutions. Works closely with development teams, business analysts, and stakeholders to select appropriate technologies, integration patterns, and implementation approaches, ensuring successful delivery of solutions based on APIs, event-driven architectures, and integration with core systems and enterprise platforms.

A hands-on architect capable of bridging business requirements and technical implementation, with strong expertise (10+ years) in designing and delivering enterprise-grade integration solutions across Java and / or .NET ecosystems in complex environments.

Company Description

Accesa is a leading technology company headquartered in Cluj-Napoca, with offices in Oradea and 20 years of experience in turning business challenges into opportunities and growth.
A value-driven organisation, it has established itself as a partner of choice for major brands in Retail, Manufacturing, Finance, and Banking. With more than 1,200 IT professionals, Accesa also has a fast-growing footprint, establishing itself as an employer of choice for IT professionals who are passionate about problem-solving through technology. Coming together in strong tech teams with a customer-centric approach, they enable businesses to grow, delivering value for our clients, partners, industry, and community.

Job Description

Our client is a trusted partner in the financial-banking sector in Germany, both in the public and private sectors who offers services for over 150,000 banking workstations and for more than 4,500 employees. It covers over 60% of banking sector in Germany.

Responsibilities:

Build Modern Digital Workplaces:
Design and develop business applications using SharePoint Online, SharePoint Framework (SPFx), React, and TypeScript, helping organisations improve collaboration and productivity.

Shape User Experiences:
Create intuitive web parts, extensions, and custom solutions that enhance employee engagement and simplify access to information across Microsoft 365 environments.

Connect the Microsoft Ecosystem:
Integrate Microsoft 365 services using Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, Entra ID, and Azure services to deliver seamless and secure business solutions.

Drive Solution Quality:
Ensure applications are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with engineering standards, security requirements, and best practices.

Partner with Customers:
Collaborate directly with stakeholders, business analysts, and architects to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.

Contribute Beyond Projects:
Share knowledge within the Microsoft 365 community, mentor colleagues, and explore emerging technologies such as Microsoft Copilot and AI-powered development tools.

Qualifications

Must Have

Experience developing solutions with SharePoint Online and SharePoint Framework (SPFx)
Advanced German & English language skills, both written and spoken
Strong knowledge of React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
Experience integrating Microsoft 365 services through Microsoft Graph API and SharePoint REST APIs
Understanding of SharePoint architecture, permissions, governance, and information architecture
Experience with Azure services such as Azure Functions, Storage, Key Vault, or API Management
Knowledge of Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile delivery practices
Experience working directly with customers and stakeholders
Strong communication and consultancy skills
Regular use of AI tools to improve productivity, automate or reduce repetitive work, support decision-making, and deliver higher-quality outcomes.

Azure Logic Apps
Infrastructure as Code concepts
Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility and Agents
Microsoft certifications such as MS-600, MS-900, AZ-204, or PL-900

As a people-first organisation, we believe diversity strengthens our teams and drives innovation. All employment decisions are based on merit, skills, and performance, without discriminating based on any personal characteristic. Enjoy our holistic benefits program that covers the four pillars that we believe come together to support our wellbeing, covering social, physical, emotional wellbeing, as well as work-life fusion.

Physical Wellbeing: Our wellbeing program includes medical benefits, gym support, and personalised fitness options for an active lifestyle, complemented by team events and the Healthy Habits Club.

Team Manager

About JiBe

JiBe is a cloud based fully integrated ERP system for the shipping industry. Our goal is to allow shipping companies to improve productivity, efficiency and safety levels, while reducing costs. JiBe ERP enables increased automation and streamlining of processes, creating pre-defined workflows and reducing the usage of email and paper.
JiBe is looking for a top-notch engineer to join our team. You will have an opportunity to directly impact our growing team.

Become a team manager for 6 team members addressing their personal and professional needs as well as participate and lead design efforts related to the solution alongside tech leads and architects.
Recruit and build a self-organizing agile team as well as implement career development and personal growth plans and enhance the team members’ technical proficiency level and soft skills.
Manage and drive execution as well as manage the development lifecycle and the day-to-day activities of the team. Assume complete ownership over the team’s products, their quality as well as the production environment and operational requirements.
Drive improvements to the team development methodologies, tools, and processes.
Invest 50% of your time in managing and growing the team and the other 50% in hands-on coding and performing code reviews as part of the team’s daily activities.

Functional validation

Provide quality metrics and automation reports to project stakeholders.

Collaborate closely with development, architecture, product, and operations teams.
Drive continuous improvement across QA practices and processes.

Experience testing enterprise applications with multiple integrations.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Strong knowledge of: REST APIs, JSON, HTTP/HTTPS

Swagger/OpenAPI
Experience with: RestAssured, Postman/Insomnia, Similar API automation tools
Strong hands-on experience with C#

TestNG / JUnit / NUnit / xUnit CI/CD
Experience with:
Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Git

Additionally

Experience with microservices architecture.

Familiarity with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) is a plus.

jobs.title: Developer ERP
jobs.description:
💚 Werk mee aan iets goeds

Jij bouwt mee aan de ERP-oplossingen die onze organisatie elke dag ondersteunen. Als Developer ERP
vertaal je functionele analyses naar slimme technische oplossingen en zorg je ervoor dat collega's vlot kunnen werken met betrouwbare systemen.
Dit is jouw impact
Je schrijft technische analyses op basis van user stories.
Je ontwikkelt nieuwe functionaliteiten binnen onze ERP-omgeving.
Je voert unit tests uit en zorgt voor kwalitatieve software.
Je werkt met databanken, SQL-queries en integraties.
Je analyseert service requests en helpt technische problemen oplossen.
Je werkt mee aan releases, code reviews en technische verbeteringen.

Je komt terecht in een agile team waar je mee nadenkt over performante, onderhoudbare en toekomstgerichte oplossingen.

💚 Jij in deze rol

Je hebt ervaring als developer binnen een ERP-omgeving, bij voorkeur Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Je werkt graag met C# en hebt interesse in integraties via REST, JSON of XML.
Je kan SQL-queries lezen, schrijven en optimaliseren.
Je bekijkt technische analyses kritisch en denkt in duurzame oplossingen.
Je neemt eigenaarschap op en vindt zelfstandig je weg binnen complexe vraagstukken.
Je communiceert helder en werkt graag samen met collega's uit verschillende domeinen.
Je kan prioriteiten verleggen wanneer nodig en blijft rustig onder sprintdeadlines.

💚 Wat mag jij van ons verwachten?

Contract van onbepaalde duur.
Fulltime werkweek van 40 uur.
Flexibele werkuren.
12 ADV-dagen + 2 extra Goed-dagen.
Maaltijdcheques van €8 per gewerkte dag.
Ecocheques van €250 per jaar (pro rata).
Groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering.
Eindejaarspremie en vakantiegeld.
Personeelskorting in onze thuiszorgwinkels.
100% terugbetaling van openbaar vervoer.
Cafetariaplan met onder meer fietslease, multimedia en andere voordelen.

💚 Waarom kiezen voor Goed?

Goed helpt mensen om zo zelfstandig en actief mogelijk in het leven te staan. Met hulpmiddelen, advies en ondersteuning maken we elke dag een verschil voor duizenden klanten.
Ook achter de schermen bouwen we voortdurend verder aan een toekomstgerichte organisatie. Daarom zoeken we collega's die mee hun schouders willen zetten onder slimme digitale oplossingen die écht impact hebben.
Goed als zorgretailer

Goed is een zorgretailer die mensen ondersteunt om zo zelfstandig en actief mogelijk deel te blijven nemen aan het dagelijkse leven — op elk moment dat zij extra hulpmiddelen of ondersteuning nodig hebben. Met een breed en gespecialiseerd aanbod aan hulpmiddelen zoals mobiliteitsoplossingen, stomamateriaal, borstprothesen, bandages en andere welzijnsproducten begeleiden we klanten in verschillende levensfases.
Goed als werkgever

Bij Goed ben je meer dan een collega, je bent een sterkmaker. Bij ons maak je écht impact. Niet door aan de zijlijn te staan, maar door mee te bouwen aan zorgoplossingen die ertoe doen. In een sector die snel verandert, krijg je bij ons de kans om je expertise te verdiepen, verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen en het verschil te maken voor onze klanten én voor onze organisatie. Je werkt in een warm team van collega’s en hebt volop doorgroeimogelijkheden.
Goesting in iets goeds? Solliciteer hier vandaag nog!

You build. You connect. You make Azure do cool things.

Are you ready to turn your Azure skills into something a little more magical? At HikoniQ
, we’re looking for an Azure Integration Developer
who gets excited about building smart, scalable, cloud-native solutions and who enjoys doing that together with a team that actually knows what they’re doing (and has fun while doing it).

What’s this role all about?

As an Azure Integration Services Developer
, you’ll be right in the middle of the action: designing, building, and fine-tuning modern integration solutions using Azure’s finest. Think Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management … the full toolkit.

You’ll work on projects where event-driven, resilient architectures aren’t just buzzwords, but the actual foundation. If that sounds like your kind of playground, you might feel very much at home here.

Why HikoniQ?

We’re part of CornerBriX
, a community of companies focused on integration, APIs, data, and security. What does that mean for you?
You’ll be surrounded by people who genuinely enjoy sharing knowledge, helping each other grow, and geeking out over integration challenges.
No pushing, no rigid career paths … just the space to grow, the support to improve, and the trust to do what you do best.

Curious to see if this could be your kind of team? Keep reading and discover whether this role is the perfect fit for you.

You’ll get to:

Build, implement, and maintain integration solutions using Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and API Management
Design and develop APIs and connectors to integrate internal and external systems
Work on asynchronous integration scenarios using Service Bus, Event Grid, and Event Hub

Join code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical brainstorm sessions (yes, your input matters)
Collaborate closely with architects and analysts to turn ideas into real, working solutions
Monitor and optimize integration flows to keep everything running smoothly and efficiently

What we’re hoping you bring:

Around 4+
years of hands-on experience with Azure Logic Apps, Function Apps, and API Management

A solid understanding of asynchronous messaging
and event-driven architectures

, or similar technologies
Strong API skills (REST, OAuth2, OpenID Connect … you know the drill)

A problem-solving mindset and a natural tendency to collaborate, because we really do things together here

Have worked in consulting or client-facing roles and know how to translate tech into real business value

A challening job
with plenty of coaching and training

jobs.title: Integration and Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
As an Integration and Automation Engineer, you'll be the technical powerhouse behind our client projects. Your responsibility will be to design, build and maintain integrations that enable enterprise systems to communicate efficiently, securely, and at scale. You'll also collaborate with multiple stakeholders to streamline and automate business processes.

What drives you?

We're seeking a community-oriented engineer who excels at solving complex integration problems, collaborating with colleagues, and exchanging knowledge. You have a genuine passion for technology and innovation, and you turn that energy into meaningful results for clients. You thrive on advising clients, steering them through technical decisions and implementations.

What do you bring to the table?

Problem-solving mindset with excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Experience with leading integration/iPaaS platforms Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, etc.).
In-depth knowledge of APIs REST, SOAP, GraphQL, etc.), messaging technologies JMS, AMQP, Kafka, etc.), and other integration patterns.
Track record integrating large enterprise IT systems SAP, Dynamics, NetSuite, Salesforce, etc.).
Experience in one or more cloud platforms Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Fluent in English. (Dutch and/or French is a plus).

Nice to have:

Experience with Kubernetes and DevOps Technologies.
Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Experience in business process modeling and automation.

What will you be doing?

You primary focus will be designing and implementing robust integration solutions, but your role extends beyond coding. You will also work closely with business stakeholders to align on process requirements and design business automation solutions.

Design, develop, and test complex integration
scenarios using leading iPaaS platforms and resilient integration patterns.
Model and optimize business processes
, working with business analysts to translate requirements into automated workflows.
Lead integration-centered projects and architectures
, including API Management, Data Integration, Application Integration, EDA, and B2B Integration.
Work with a diverse range of clients
, including public sector organizations and international enterprises. Always taking a pragmatic approach.
Grow as an expert
by focusing on knowledge, absorbing the experience from peers, and actively contributing to the i8c community.

What do we offer?

Become part of the biggest integration community in Belgium
: you'll find a group of like-minded integration experts, each with their own areas of interest and expertise. From Event-driven Architecture and API Management to security and DevOps, we all share a passion for knowledge sharing and technical discussions.
You're in the driver's seat of your career path
: your career is in your hands. Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or a specialist, we are here to support your ambitions.
Continuous learning opportunities
: you get the opportunity to collaborate on innovative initiatives and expand your knowledge, and we provide access to training to guide you on your path.
Enjoy the freedom to work where you're most productive
: our team operates in a hybrid mode, splitting time between the customer's sites, our offices in Kontich, Ghent, and at home.
Great remuneration package
: you can count on a competitive salary along with numerous extra-legal benefits (company car, fuel card, laptop, phone, mobile subscription, insurance,...)

Headquartered in Switzerland, our business spans across 18 countries, and has been supporting the healthcare industry for 160 years by providing them with technology to enable them to support their communities.

In deze functie combineer je twee uitdagende werelden. Enerzijds ben je het aanspreekpunt voor klanten wanneer zij ondersteuning nodig hebben. Anderzijds zorg je ervoor dat onze software kwalitatief, stabiel en betrouwbaar blijft door testautomatisatie en kwaliteitscontroles.

Je analyseert technische vraagstukken, zoekt mee naar de oorzaak van incidenten en zorgt ervoor dat issues efficiënt hun weg vinden naar de juiste oplossing. Tegelijk werk je aan geautomatiseerde testen en releasevalidaties, zodat problemen worden opgespoord nog vóór ze impact hebben op klanten.

Je werkt nauw samen met onze developers en met partners zoals Microsoft, Tungsten en dox42.

Geen enkele dag is hetzelfde. Je verdeelt je aandacht tussen support, analyse en kwaliteitsbewaking.

Je behandelt supportvragen en incidenten.
Je analyseert en reproduceert technische problemen.
Je begeleidt klanten via e-mail, Teams en telefoon.
Je bewaakt de opvolging en communicatie van issues van A tot Z.
Je stemt af met externe softwareleveranciers wanneer nodig.
Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van onze software

Je helpt onze QA-aanpak en teststrategie verder uitbouwen.

Wat Je Mag Verwachten

Een aantrekkelijk verloningspakket met een competitief salaris, maaltijdcheques, hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering én een elektrische firmawagen met laadpas.
Flexibiliteit via ons 9A Flexplan, waarmee je jouw eindejaarspremie kan inzetten voor voordelen die voor jou belangrijk zijn, zoals extra IT-materiaal of een ergonomische thuiswerkplek.
Een sterke start én groeitraject op maat. Dankzij een uitgebreide onboarding en een persoonlijk ontwikkelingsplan werk je samen met je teamlead aan jouw ambities, interesses en professionele groei.
Blijven leren zit in ons DNA. Via opleidingen, certificeringen en kennisdeling binnen de 9A-community krijg je alle kansen om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.
Een afwisselende en impactvolle rol waarin testing, support en technologie samenkomen en je dagelijks het verschil maakt voor klanten en collega's.
Samenwerking over landsgrenzen heen. Je maakt deel uit van de internationale 9altitudes-groep en werkt samen met collega's uit verschillende landen, waardoor je kennis en best practices breed kan inzetten.
Een hecht team en sterke bedrijfscultuur. Van afterworks en business updates tot onze Family Day, Summer Event en Elevate Together Day: verbinding staat centraal.

Met meer dan 750 collega’s in 9 landen combineren we diepgaande expertise in o.a. ERP, CE, BI & AI, Document Management, PLM, IoT & Augmented Reality, CAD en eCommerce. Samen creëren we meer dan oplossingen: we leveren échte waarde en zetten mee de toon voor duurzame resultaten bij onze klanten.

Klaar om met ons mee te groeien en je carrière naar nieuwe hoogtes te tillen? Zet vandaag nog de eerste stap in jouw nieuwe avontuur en solliciteer eenvoudig via onze website.

jobs.title: Medior/Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Medior/Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer (Belgium)

LANGUAGES

English
REQUESTED START DATE

5 Oct 2026

The Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) is responsible for the design, governance and scaling our Azure and self-service platform.
We are looking for a senior engineer to help clean up the technical depth — from landing zone architecture to Terraform Enterprise module engineering, networking
design and enterprise system integrations. This is a medior/senior individual contributor role: you're expected to work independently on well-defined scopes, but you'll be ramping up within an existing team structure rather than owning the full platform strategy from day one.
Current Situation
Our Azure platform has grown fast — more application teams, more subscriptions, more consumers of our self-service capabilities every quarter. That growth has been a success story, but it also means parts of our platform (governance controls, identity and access processes, networking/DNS patterns, and our Terraform Enterprise setup) were built for an earlier stage of adoption and now need to be modernized to keep pace with scale.
We're tackling this step by step: moving toward more standardized, automated and maintainable ways of working across governance, identity, networking and infrastructure-as-code, so the platform can keep scaling without a proportional increase in manual effort.
To do that well, we're expanding the team with senior engineers who can contribute on two fronts: keeping day-to-day platform operations running smoothly for the teams that depend on us, while also helping design and build the more standardized, scalable solutions we're moving toward.
Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Act as second-line escalation for Azure platform issues (RBAC, DNS, VNET/Private Endpoint connectivity, AD integration, Terraform Enterprise runs) and write up root cause analyses.
Maintain and incrementally improve landing zones, archetypes, Azure Policy and naming/tagging standards; process governance exception requests.
Build, version and maintain Terraform modules; review consumer changes and evaluate Azure Verified Modules (AVM) as replacements for custom modules.
Handle recurring IAM tickets (RBAC assignments, group memberships, access troubleshooting) and contribute to cleanup of legacy/exception-based access.
Support DNS/connectivity requests and troubleshooting across the hybrid environment within existing patterns.
Maintain and troubleshoot existing PowerShell automation scripts used across platform operations.
Keep governance documentation current and contribute to internal Terraform Enterprise workshops and application team enablement.

Required Technical Expertise
Azure (hands-on production experience required)
Governance: management groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy (built-in and custom), RBAC design and troubleshooting.
Identity: Microsoft Entra ID — group-based access models, app registrations, managed identities, service principals.
Networking: VNET peering/hub-spoke, Private Endpoints, Private DNS Zones, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, hybrid/on-prem DNS
integration.
Landing zone concepts aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) archetypes.
Exposure to Azure Databricks networking (VNet injection) is a plus.

Infrastructure as Code
Solid production-level Terraform authoring — designing, versioning and publishing modules, not just consuming them.
Terraform Enterprise or Terraform Cloud experience specifically: workspaces, private module registry, VCS-driven workflows, policy checks (Sentinel/OPA).
Familiarity with Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and module lifecycle/versioning practices.

DevOps & Automation
CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps preferred): build/release pipelines, YAML pipelines, service connections.
Scripting for automation and troubleshooting (PowerShell, Bash or Python).
Comfortable working with KQL/Log Analytics for diagnostics is a plus.

Identity & Access Management
Practical RBAC design and troubleshooting at enterprise scale (role assignments, group nesting, inheritance issues, propagation delays).
Experience managing access for both human users and service/application identities.
Understanding of access governance concepts (ownership, periodic reviews, exception handling).

Networking
Solid understanding of enterprise DNS architecture, including hybrid on- prem/cloud scenarios.
Experience troubleshooting connectivity issues across VNETs, firewalls, and hybrid links.

Prior Experience we're Looking For
4–7 years in a cloud platform engineering, DevOps or infrastructure engineering role, ideally within a large, governed enterprise (not a greenfield/startup environment).
Demonstrated experience operating (not just building) an Azure landing zone platform at scale — supporting real application teams with real tickets.
Prior role involving Terraform Enterprise/Cloud in a production capacity, ideally including module authorship and CI/CD integration.
Experience working across team boundaries (IAM, Networking, Security, external partners/vendors) to resolve platform issues.
Microsoft certifications (AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-305, or Terraform Associate) are a strong plus but not a substitute for demonstrable hands-on experience.

Personal Characteristics
Can operate independently on a well-scoped task from day one — this is a "plug in and go"; role, not a ramp-up position.
Comfortable working in a live, legacy-entangled environment where not everything is fully standardized yet.
Detail-oriented, especially around governance, documentation and naming/tagging consistency.
Good communicator — able to support application teams directly without needing everything translated by the platform lead.
Takes ownership of tickets/incidents end-to-end rather than escalating prematurely

Location: Kontich, Belgium
