🎯 What drives us - We're obsessed with helping members live healthier

Mission is the Boss
: long-term thinking, mission above all else
Member & customer-led
: obsessed with solving problems and delighting users

🏆 How we build excellence - We hire the best and empower them to succeed

Champions of excellence
: extremely high standards and talent density
Distributed ownership
: everyone owns their decisions and results
Radically transparent
: all information accessible, written-first, async decisions

🤝 How we grow together - We improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

Optimistic alchemy
: optimists who collaborate with genuine care
Empathetic challengers
: direct, caring feedback to help each other grow
Bold contrarians
: think differently, try new approaches

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters

Disciplined execution
: decisive action with compounding focus
Fight for simplicity
: high-impact processes, smart frugality

⭐ The Engineering team ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Our stack is Python/Flask, React, React Native, PostgreSQL.

Want to know more? Read this article if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan and this article on our Engineering career path.

🌐 Enabling Global-First product development

In Alan's early expansion, we made a strategic decision to create separate codebases for each country we ventured into. This approach allowed us to quickly adapt and tailor our applications to meet the unique healthcare and regulatory requirements of France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada.

In 2024, we reached a crucial point where it was essential to merge these codebases into global, configurable modules
. Yet, writing local code is still easier than building global solutions. The Global Architecture team is central to this transformation — our goal is to enable any team at Alan to develop and launch features seamlessly across markets, as outlined in our 2025 technical strategy.

🚀 Your mission

Design Cross-Cutting Modules
You'll transform country-specific implementations into elegant global components that will become the new building blocks of other teams to build global features
Remove Technical Blockers for Product Teams
You’ll tackle technical blockers that cut across several domains and eliminate the need for team-specific workarounds, allowing product teams to focus on their core business
Orchestrate Data Transformations
You'll implement strategies to harmonize different countries' data models without losing local flexibility and consolidate existing data into unified schemas
Build and Own What You Create
You'll be responsible for the entire lifecycle of your solutions, from initial design through long-term maintenance. We don't just design — we build, deploy, and maintain what we create

🌟 Why This Role Matters

Focus on High-Impact, Cross-Domain Solutions
You work exclusively on blockers that span multiple business domains that are heavily depended upon. This means every solution you build has an impact across multiple teams
Enable Teams, Don't Replace Them
Your job isn't to substitute other teams or globalize everything. Instead, you'll work on technical obstacles that prevent teams from building global-first solutions and work with them to remove those obstacles
Learn and Share Globalization Patterns
As you design and implement global solutions, you'll develop an expertise in globalization patterns. You'll share these learnings with other teams, helping them make better decisions about global vs. local solutions in their own work

🚀 What we're looking for

You write code and maintain what you build. At Alan there is no architect in an ivory tower, we implement what we design
You’re able to navigate complex systems spanning multiple business domains and technical boundaries
You've worked with diverse architectural patterns and can articulate the nuanced trade-offs between them
You can spot technical obstacles that are blocking multiple teams and design solutions that remove those obstacles

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We are looking for problem-solver engineers with 5+ years of experience who get excited about simplifying complex business problems:

You’ll be able to tackle high-impact & high-risk projects involving many engineers.
You’ll design efficient systems and engineering practices to align with and facilitate interactions between multiple teams/products.
You’ll have the opportunity to mentor other engineers & lead crews (more details in this article).
You’ll be able to contribute to hiring your future coworkers and shape candidates’ hiring experience (improving our technical assessment process etc...)

You would be a good fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

Well-versed in Object Oriented Programming such as Python, Java, C#, and enthusiastic about web technologies such as modern Javascript.
Willing to work in Python/JavaScript (but you don’t need to have experience with those 2 languages!).
Passionate about building products.
Self-starting and entrepreneurial.
Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!).
Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching.
Fluent in English (no need to speak French!).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need,
and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time
with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

Fair rewards
. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.
Flexible Office
. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.
All the tools you need
. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.
Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours
. Organize your time as you wish.
Delightful healthcare insurance:
Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).
Transport
. Country-specific commuter benefits.
Learning & Training opportunities.
A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.
Personal growth through coaching
: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk -
it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.
Learn more about our coaching culture
.

Parental leave.
Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you.
Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
EasyPost is looking for a hands-on Senior Software Engineer to help build and operate our secure document-delivery platform.

Our customers use EasyPost to send invoices and business documents through channels such as Peppol e-invoicing, Belgian eBox, electronic registered delivery, e-signing, email and print. Behind this experience is a large event-driven AWS platform that processes sensitive documents, integrates with external providers and coordinates long-running delivery workflows.

You will take ownership of features from technical design through production. This role focuses on backend and cloud engineering. You will work closely with our team lead, product management and other engineers to design reliable, secure and maintainable solutions.

As one of the team’s senior engineers, you will also help shape the platform’s architecture, evaluate technical trade-offs and turn business requirements into practical technical designs.

What You Will Do

Design and develop TypeScript services, AWS Lambda functions and NestJS APIs.
Build and maintain serverless infrastructure using AWS CDK.
Translate business requirements into clear technical designs together with the team lead.
Contribute to architectural decisions and document their context, trade-offs and consequences.
Create resilient event-driven workflows that handle retries, duplicate events, timeouts, concurrency and partial failures.
Integrate with external e-invoicing, e-delivery and e-signing providers through APIs and webhooks.
Work with AWS services such as Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3 and CloudWatch.
Apply security practices including encryption, least-privilege access, audit logging and safe handling of sensitive data.
Write unit, integration and end-to-end tests using Jest.
Monitor production systems and investigate issues across application code, AWS infrastructure and external integrations.
Review code, mentor colleagues and raise engineering standards across the team.
Improve our development, CI/CD and deployment processes.
Collaborate with frontend engineers to ensure backend services and APIs support complete, reliable user journeys.

jobs.title: Support & Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Zorg jij ervoor dat software niet alleen werkt, maar ook blijft werken?

Een Support & Test Automation Engineer speelt een sleutelrol tussen klanten, softwareontwikkeling en kwaliteit.

In deze functie combineer je twee uitdagende werelden. Enerzijds ben je het aanspreekpunt voor klanten wanneer zij ondersteuning nodig hebben. Anderzijds zorg je ervoor dat onze software kwalitatief, stabiel en betrouwbaar blijft door testautomatisatie en kwaliteitscontroles.

Je analyseert technische vraagstukken, zoekt mee naar de oorzaak van incidenten en zorgt ervoor dat issues efficiënt hun weg vinden naar de juiste oplossing. Tegelijk werk je aan geautomatiseerde testen en releasevalidaties, zodat problemen worden opgespoord nog vóór ze impact hebben op klanten.

Je werkt nauw samen met onze developers en met partners zoals Microsoft, Tungsten en dox42.

Je dagelijkse avontuur

Geen enkele dag is hetzelfde. Je verdeelt je aandacht tussen support, analyse en kwaliteitsbewaking.

Je helpt klanten vooruit
Je behandelt supportvragen en incidenten.
Je analyseert en reproduceert technische problemen.
Je begeleidt klanten via e-mail, Teams en telefoon.
Je bewaakt de opvolging en communicatie van issues van A tot Z.
Je stemt af met externe softwareleveranciers wanneer nodig.
Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van onze software
Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt geautomatiseerde testen met Playwright.
Je voert functionele testen, regressietesten en releasevalidaties uit.
Je controleert nieuwe functionaliteiten en bugfixes.
Je detecteert risico's en denkt mee na over verbeteringen.
Je helpt onze QA-aanpak en teststrategie verder uitbouwen.

Vaardigheden

Jij krijgt energie van het uitpluizen van complexe vraagstukken en laat niet los tot je begrijpt wat er speelt.

Daarnaast Herken Je Jezelf In Onderstaande Punten

Je hebt ervaring met software testing, technische support of beide.
Je hebt ervaring met Playwright of een gelijkaardig testautomatiseringsframework.
Je hebt een technische achtergrond en kan code lezen, begrijpen en gebruiken om problemen te analyseren.
Je denkt analytisch en werkt oplossingsgericht.
Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels.
Je bent klantgericht en voelt je comfortabel in rechtstreeks contact met klanten.
Je neemt ownership en volgt zaken consequent op.
Je werkt graag samen met collega's en externe partners.

Mooi Meegenomen

Ervaring met Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Kennis van Azure, SQL, API's of integraties.
Ervaring met supportprocessen of ticketingsystemen.
Kennis van ERP-, workflow- of document management oplossingen.

Je travelpack wordt gevuld met

Bij 9altitudes krijg je niet zomaar een job, maar de kans om mee te bouwen aan software en oplossingen die het verschil maken voor onze klanten.

Je komt terecht in een gespecialiseerd team waar samenwerking, kennisdeling en persoonlijke groei centraal staan.

Wat Je Mag Verwachten

Een aantrekkelijk verloningspakket met een competitief salaris, maaltijdcheques, hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering én een elektrische firmawagen met laadpas.
Flexibiliteit via ons 9A Flexplan, waarmee je jouw eindejaarspremie kan inzetten voor voordelen die voor jou belangrijk zijn, zoals extra IT-materiaal of een ergonomische thuiswerkplek.
Een sterke start én groeitraject op maat. Dankzij een uitgebreide onboarding en een persoonlijk ontwikkelingsplan werk je samen met je teamlead aan jouw ambities, interesses en professionele groei.
Blijven leren zit in ons DNA. Via opleidingen, certificeringen en kennisdeling binnen de 9A-community krijg je alle kansen om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.
Een afwisselende en impactvolle rol waarin testing, support en technologie samenkomen en je dagelijks het verschil maakt voor klanten en collega's.
Samenwerking over landsgrenzen heen. Je maakt deel uit van de internationale 9altitudes-groep en werkt samen met collega's uit verschillende landen, waardoor je kennis en best practices breed kan inzetten.
Een hecht team en sterke bedrijfscultuur. Van afterworks en business updates tot onze Family Day, Summer Event en Elevate Together Day: verbinding staat centraal.
De kans om mee te groeien met een ambitieuze organisatie. Jouw ideeën en expertise dragen rechtstreeks bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van 9altitudes in België en Europa.
Een innovatieve werkomgeving waarin je werkt met moderne technologieën en deel uitmaakt van een Microsoft Gold Partner met een sterke focus op digitale transformatie.

Neem contact op

Bij 9altitudeskrijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de internationale voorloper op technologie en procesoptimalisatie. Met meer dan 750 collega’s in 9 landen combineren we diepgaande expertise in o.a. ERP, CE, BI & AI, Document Management, PLM, IoT & Augmented Reality, CAD en eCommerce. Samen creëren we meer dan oplossingen: we leveren échte waarde en zetten mee de toon voor duurzame resultaten bij onze klanten.

Klaar om met ons mee te groeien en je carrière naar nieuwe hoogtes te tillen? Zet vandaag nog de eerste stap in jouw nieuwe avontuur en solliciteer eenvoudig via onze website.

Wil je zien hoe wij samen grenzen verleggen, innovatieve business solutions creëren en hoogtepunten vieren? Volg ons dan op LinkedIn en blijf op de hoogte van onze projecten, successen en events.

About The Job

The Middle Tier Technical Support team is looking for a Systems Technical Support Engineer to provide technical support for customers using SAS 9.4 and SAS Viya environments. Our team supports the systems, services, and infrastructure that enable SAS web applications to run securely, reliably, and at scale. We help customers troubleshoot complex issues across web and application servers, authentication and single sign-on, security and encryption, clustering and performance.

In this role, you will join a highly collaborative global team working at the intersection of systems engineering, customer success, and SAS technology. You will have the opportunity to work with a broad range of technologies, solve challenging technical problems, and develop expertise across both traditional SAS 9.4 architectures and modern SAS Viya environments.

Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across SAS 9.4 and SAS Viya environments, with a focus on middle-tier systems, SAS Web applications, including SAS Web Server, SAS Web Application Server, HTTP/HTTPS services.
Diagnose and resolve authentication, single sign-on, security, and encryption issues involving technologies such as Kerberos, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, Integrated Windows Authentication (IWA).
Support highly available and clustered environments by troubleshooting clustering, JMS brokers and cache locator services.
Ensure all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization's secure software development goals.
Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity, and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.

Required Qualifications

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in software development, software testing, an applicable business domain, software consulting, or supporting complex software applications.

Working knowledge of Windows and UNIX operating systems.
Experience with Java and JVM-based applications, enterprise application servers Java stack traces, TCP/IP and networking, file system security, and advanced web technologies such as web authentication, SSL/TLS, web services, SOAP, and DAV
Previous technical support experience supporting enterprise software applications, with the ability to manage multiple customer issues and priorities in a deadline-driven environment

Technical Knowledge & Skills: Demonstrates strong knowledge of web technologies, operating systems, authentication, security, and performance troubleshooting.
Customer Orientation: Recognize customer needs, communicate effectively, and help remove barriers that may affect customer success and retention.
Collaborating: Works effectively with customers and colleagues across Technical Support, R&D, Product Management, Professional Services, and other teams to investigate issues, share knowledge, and drive complex problems to resolution.
Continuous Learning: Actively identifying new areas for learning; regularly creating and taking advantage of learning opportunities; using newly gained knowledge and skill on the job and learning through their application.

jobs.title: Fullstack Software Engineer (x/f/m) - Global Architecture
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait
.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance.
Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a
unique culture
. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤘 How we do it ?

About

People joining Alan are always surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us - We're obsessed with helping members live healthier

Mission is the Boss
: long-term thinking, mission above all else
Member & customer-led
: obsessed with solving problems and delighting users

🏆 How we build excellence - We hire the best and empower them to succeed

Champions of excellence
: extremely high standards and talent density
Distributed ownership
: everyone owns their decisions and results
Radically transparent
: all information accessible, written-first, async decisions

🤝 How we grow together - We improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

Optimistic alchemy
: optimists who collaborate with genuine care
Empathetic challengers
: direct, caring feedback to help each other grow
Bold contrarians
: think differently, try new approaches

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters

Disciplined execution
: decisive action with compounding focus
Fight for simplicity
: high-impact processes, smart frugality

⭐ The Engineering team ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Our stack is Python/Flask, React, React Native, PostgreSQL.

Want to know more? Read this article if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan and this article on our Engineering career path.

🌐 Enabling Global-First product development

In Alan's early expansion, we made a strategic decision to create separate codebases for each country we ventured into. This approach allowed us to quickly adapt and tailor our applications to meet the unique healthcare and regulatory requirements of France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada.

In 2024, we reached a crucial point where it was essential to merge these codebases into global, configurable modules
. Yet, writing local code is still easier than building global solutions. The Global Architecture team is central to this transformation — our goal is to enable any team at Alan to develop and launch features seamlessly across markets, as outlined in our 2025 technical strategy.

🚀 Your mission

Design Cross-Cutting Modules
You'll transform country-specific implementations into elegant global components that will become the new building blocks of other teams to build global features
Remove Technical Blockers for Product Teams
You’ll tackle technical blockers that cut across several domains and eliminate the need for team-specific workarounds, allowing product teams to focus on their core business
Orchestrate Data Transformations
You'll implement strategies to harmonize different countries' data models without losing local flexibility and consolidate existing data into unified schemas
Build and Own What You Create
You'll be responsible for the entire lifecycle of your solutions, from initial design through long-term maintenance. We don't just design — we build, deploy, and maintain what we create

🌟 Why This Role Matters

Focus on High-Impact, Cross-Domain Solutions
You work exclusively on blockers that span multiple business domains that are heavily depended upon. This means every solution you build has an impact across multiple teams
Enable Teams, Don't Replace Them
Your job isn't to substitute other teams or globalize everything. Instead, you'll work on technical obstacles that prevent teams from building global-first solutions and work with them to remove those obstacles
Learn and Share Globalization Patterns
As you design and implement global solutions, you'll develop an expertise in globalization patterns. You'll share these learnings with other teams, helping them make better decisions about global vs. local solutions in their own work

🚀 What we're looking for

You write code and maintain what you build. At Alan there is no architect in an ivory tower, we implement what we design
You’re able to navigate complex systems spanning multiple business domains and technical boundaries
You've worked with diverse architectural patterns and can articulate the nuanced trade-offs between them
You can spot technical obstacles that are blocking multiple teams and design solutions that remove those obstacles

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We are looking for problem-solver engineers with 5+ years of experience who get excited about simplifying complex business problems:

You’ll be able to tackle high-impact & high-risk projects involving many engineers.
You’ll design efficient systems and engineering practices to align with and facilitate interactions between multiple teams/products.
You’ll have the opportunity to mentor other engineers & lead crews (more details in this article).
You’ll be able to contribute to hiring your future coworkers and shape candidates’ hiring experience (improving our technical assessment process etc...)

You would be a good fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

Well-versed in Object Oriented Programming such as Python, Java, C#, and enthusiastic about web technologies such as modern Javascript.
Willing to work in Python/JavaScript (but you don’t need to have experience with those 2 languages!).
Passionate about building products.
Self-starting and entrepreneurial.
Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!).
Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching.
Fluent in English (no need to speak French!).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need,
and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time
with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

Fair rewards
. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.
Flexible Office
. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.
All the tools you need
. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.
Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours
. Organize your time as you wish.
Delightful healthcare insurance:
Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).
Transport
. Country-specific commuter benefits.
Learning & Training opportunities.
A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.
Personal growth through coaching
: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk -
it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.
Learn more about our coaching culture
.

Parental leave.
Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you.
Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman
: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

Note: While you're applying for a specific area,, you may join a different engineering team based on where we think you'll have the most impact. Check out descriptions of other areas here .

jobs.title: Clinical Data Engineer CDP & DP
jobs.description:
Main Purpose

Drives the setup and maintenance of clinical data collection instrument(s), data ingestion and integration capabilities from all study data sources (sites and vendors – labs, IRT, ePRO, digital devices, etc.), based on the Clinical Study Protocol and Medical Standards in collaboration with the study team and other internal as well as external stakeholders.

Implements programs/listings for data quality checks as well as builds optimized data flow pipelines to enable risk monitoring processes (CDM, Med Review, Site Management, Med Coding) and statistical analysis/reporting.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

Requirements & Specification: Analyze clinical protocol to create requirements and technical specifications for data collection, data ingestion, quality measures, data integration and transformation for all study sources ensuring complete end-to-end focus.
Task Delivery: Setup study level data collection elements as well as program triggers, derivations and data cleaning checks/listings/reports. Setup and perform data ingestion activities for CRO and vendor data, data exchanges with internal and external partner systems, as per agreed data transfer specifications. Develop and validate programs for study setup, conduct and closeout activities within the Clinical Data Environment/Lakehouse. Provide clinical study data to business users, ensuring smooth data flow and traceability while addressing any data flow issues.
Project Management: Plan, prioritize, and communicate timelines for clinical studies. Support these studies throughout their lifecycle by evaluating issues, assessing the impact of changes, and implementing and testing updates. Ensure all study setup documentation is completed on time and comply with relevant SOPs to be ready for inspections and audits.
Best Practices: Contribute as a subject matter expert for function level processes, systems/tools.

Scope

Global

Key Work Relations (Internal/External)

Clinical Study Team Members: Study Managers, Study Data Managers, Medical Experts, Statisticians, Statistical Programmers, Medical Writing, Drug Safety, Medical Coding)
Technology Related Partners: IT System Owners, DSA&I Process Managers/Clinical Data Engineers/Project Managers/Scrum Masters  
Enabling Functions: Standards Management, Vendor Management, Procurement, Customer Centricity, etc. 
External vendors and partner companies 

Skills & Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Natural Sciences, Life Sciences, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science or related fields. Equivalent degrees or certifications may be accepted.
Experience: At least 3 years in a scientific, data-driven position, preferably with experience working in the clinical data management discipline.
Technology & Programming: In-depth experience in programming languages (e.g., C#, SQL, SAS, Python, R) and clinical information systems following software development processes.
Familiarity with big data technologies, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), and data integration tools (e.g., Databricks).
Industry Practices - Preferred: Understanding of global regulatory requirements and guidelines (e.g., ICH, GCP, HIPAA) related to clinical investigations and data collection. Knowledge of CDISC clinical data standards.
Self Organization: Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global environment. 
Communication & Collaboration: Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal. Proven ability to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders demonstrating decision making capabilities.

jobs.title: Associate Applied (AI) Value Engineer (Nordics) - Orbit Program
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Location: Madrid for an onboarding period of 2 years and a possible relocation to Stockholm or Copenhagen after. Customer base will be in the Nordics region, involving travel to meet clients in person.

Start date: 1st of February 2027.

Role Description

As an Applied (AI) Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.

Launch Your Enterprise Software Career - Orbit Graduate program

Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12-month Orbit Program.

During the Orbit Graduate program, you will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching & mentoring.

This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.

Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:

Discovery & AI Solutioning
Building and coding within the Celonis platform (SQL, PQL and Python)
Scoping business and technical requirements
Effectively handling objections
Developing industry domain knowledge
Delivering impactful presentations and demos
Understanding value selling and realization
Managing customer accounts

What You'll Do:

AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle
Hackathons & Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a “can-do“ attitude and don’t shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems
Agentic Process Transformation: Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
Proof Projects: End-to-end execution of business-critical Proof-of-Value projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence tailored to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy.
Specialize in Domains or Industries: To scale knowledge across the organization specialize in domains (e.g. supply chain) and industries
Business Impact Presentations: Articulate and quantify strategic business value for customers, delivering impactful presentations to senior executives to ensure successful value realization for customers.
Ensure Successful Project Outcome: Applied AI Value Engineers stay involved with projects until agreed value & adoption thresholds are reached
Best Practice Modeling: Contribute to the Global Value Engineering Center of Excellence by creating reusable collateral, best practices, and tools.

What You Need:

Degree in Engineering, Data Analytics/Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related STEM field.
Excellent academic performance
Extensive internship experience or 1-2 years of full-time work experience. Ideally at the intersection of business and technology.
Understanding of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt/context engineering, multi-agent orchestration, multimodal understanding, or fine-tuning that are used to build high-impact use cases like intelligent chatbots and automated text processors.
Good knowledge of Python and common ML libraries (such as LangChain, pandas, pydantic, sklearn, PyTorch) as well as data engineering tools and technologies.
Excellent analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply technology to business challenges.
A customer-centric mindset with a focus on delivering value.
Confidence in presenting to diverse audiences.
A proactive approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to learn from mistakes.
Curiosity, self-motivation, a commitment to continuous learning, and the desire to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and execute on deadlines.
Excellent communication skills and fluency in English and at least one Nordic language (Finnish, Danish, Norwegian, Swedish, etc.).
Foundational business acumen and domain understanding, e.g. in areas such as Supply Chain.

Bonus Points:

Degrees combining technical (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science) and business (e.g., Economics, Marketing) skills.
Customer-facing, customer success/service, or sales experience.
Hands-on experience with technical Proof of Concept projects
Hands-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering
Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages.
Supply Chain process experience (Procurement, Order Management, Inventory Management, Production).
Experience modeling ROI and TCO for business case justification.
Experience with ERPs such as SAP and/or Oracle

What Celonis can offer you:

Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

jobs.description:
Wolters Kluwer is a global leader in information services and solutions for professionals in the finance, tax and accounting, risk and compliance, health and legal sectors. We help our customers make critical decisions every day by providing expert solutions that combine deep domain knowledge with specialized technology and services.

We are looking for someone who:

Is entrepreneurial and self-directed
Has a passion for technology
Has experience in .NET software development
Is interested in helping us translate our strategy into cloud solutions
Is a true agile polyglot developer with a strong interest in several of the following domains:
Back-end development in C#, Visual Studio, ...
DevOps
Cloud architecture
UX
Cloud (Azure)
Can communicate clearly with various stakeholders
Is a team player and wants to be a fantastic colleague

About The Business Unit Tax & Accounting Software

The Business Unit Tax & Accounting Software develops and sells products for tax and accounting professionals. Our BU offers a wide range of software solutions: ERP software; accounting, financial and tax advisory, and practice management software.

To support the digital transformation of our BU, we are looking for a Senior Backend Developer Cloud Solutions.

You will work with a team of about 6 people located across different sites. You will mainly work from one of our Porto office, but occasionally travel to other locations.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will play a key role in transitioning our software products to the cloud. Your tasks and responsibilities include:

Being part of an agile development team that values timely delivery of high-quality cloud software
Focusing on one ongoing project while also being involved in new initiatives
Developing business logic, designing database interactions, and APIs
Understanding the basic principles of testing and test automation
Accurately estimating the impact of requirements on technology and applications based on your expertise
Challenging requirements and designs and providing constructive input
Handling complex architectures and code structures
Collaborating closely with the Technical Architect and Product Owner
Supporting and mentoring junior colleagues

You’ll join a dynamic and ambitious team! The role offers variety and autonomy. You’ll work with up-to-date tools, databases, and documentation to perform your job efficiently.

Because we have to (otherwise you wouldn’t have found this vacancy), here’s a look at our tech stack:

C#, .NET Standard, Azure DevOps, Test Driven Development, Entity Framework, Domain Driven Design, ASP.NET Core, Azure, App Services, App Insights, Git, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, SASS, Azure Service Bus, SQL Elastic Pools, Azure Functions, Redis, Power BI, Elastic SQL Jobs, API Gateway, ARM templates, Azure AD, Identity Server, OWIN, OAuth2, OpenID Connect

Working together

Hybrid: This is a hybrid role, where you will spend at least eight days a month at our office, where you´ll enjoy the benefits of connecting and collaborating with your colleagues in person.

Join us, at Wolters Kluwer, and be part of a global technology company that makes a difference every day. Be the difference. If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Nilfisk's Digital Product department builds the software around the machines: customer portals, connected-machine and fleet services, mobile apps, service and field tooling, internal applications for our own colleagues. Today that is cross-functional product teams working on different products, and it is growing.

We are hiring our first Solution Architect to make those products add up to one landscape rather than separate ones. You will define the target architecture, and the shared building blocks our teams design within. You will also be the person the organisation comes to when a new idea, product or roadmap needs an architectural answer, and the person who says, clearly and early, what it will take.

How We Will Work, And Where You Fit

Our product teams are cross-functional and durable. A Product Owner, UX and engineers own a problem area end to end, from discovery through to running it in production. They make their own technical decisions inside their boundary, and we intend to keep it that way.

That shapes this role in a specific way. You are not an approval gate, and you do not design other teams' services for them. You own the decisions that cross team boundaries, and for everything else you make the good path the easy path: clear patterns, reusable building blocks, sensible defaults, and documentation developers actually read. A team should build within your architecture because it is the fastest route to something that lasts, not because someone mandated it.

What You Will Own

The target architecture for the Digital Product portfolio, and a realistic roadmap to get there from where we are
The principles, reference architectures and design standards teams work within, and the boundaries between products and teams
The shared building blocks: integration and event patterns, API standards, identity, and how customer, product and service data is owned and shared across products
Architectural evaluation of new work: proposals, roadmaps, partner technologies. What fits, what it takes to build, what it reuses, what it breaks, what it costs to run. A clear early answer with the reasoning attached
Honest assessment of what we already have, on a regular cadence, and a clear statement of what needs to change
Security, GDPR privacy by design and operability built into the architecture from the start, working with our Security team and our DevOps function on how solutions are built, released and run
Design review for internal teams and external development partners, early enough that the feedback still matters
The architecture record: decisions written down, documentation and diagrams kept current
Growing architectural judgement in the teams, through coaching and pairing, so it does not all live with one person

Throughout, we will expect you to

Say no with a rationale, and say yes quickly when it is a yes. Both matter
Be clear about uncertainty. A rough estimate with an honest error bar is worth more to us than a precise number that turns out to be wrong
Translate trade-offs into business terms for Product Owners and management, without flattening the technical substance
Write things down. Decision records and current diagrams are part of the work, not admin that comes after it

Essential

What we are looking for

Substantial experience as a solution architect across a portfolio of products, including setting the architecture other teams build within
A track record of evaluating proposals and existing solutions and giving an organisation a clear architectural answer with a rationale. We will ask you to walk us through what you assessed, what you recommended, and what actually changed as a result
Hands-on depth in modern application architecture: APIs, event-driven integration, microservices where they earn their keep and modular monoliths where they do not, and the judgement to tell which is which
Production experience with cloud-native architecture on Microsoft Azure, including the platform services, data stores and integration services you would actually reach for
Experience designing user-facing digital products (web, mobile, portals) and integrating them with enterprise systems such as ERP and CRM
Experience working inside an enterprise architecture you do not control, aligning product architecture with IT-owned systems, standards and governance
Professional English, written and spoken

Also valuable

Data architecture in a product context: modelling, ownership, sharing across products, privacy by design
Application security and identity in practice: authentication, authorisation, secret handling
Designing for operability, resilience and cost where teams run what they build
Working with external development partners, including reviewing their designs and deliverables
Connected products, telemetry or IoT at scale
Experience in an organisation moving from project delivery to product teams

Application

Please apply with your CV through our careers portal. We review applications continuously and close the position once we find the right match, so we encourage you to apply early. We do not accept unsolicited applications outside posted roles.

If you have questions about the role, please contact Simon Gaarden Prochnow, sgaardenprochnow@nilfisk.com

Let’s create a cleaner future together

Cleaning has emerged as a key contributor to health and safety, sparked by technology and innovation. At Nilfisk we are a driving force in this development. Being part of Nilfisk means thinking outside of the box, bringing your inspiring ideas to life, sharing the results, and learning from your setbacks. We believe that diversity is our greatest strength – as we achieve the best results from a wide variety of views and approaches. At Nilfisk, you have the freedom to be yourself and express your opinions. Nilfisk is firmly committed to growth and sustainability in everything we do. You will be empowered in your role as you collaborate with passionate colleagues on a quest to create a cleaner future.

Are you ready to make a change for a cleaner future

We are a proud member of the United Nations Global Compact.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst — CTRM Platform (Systems Design)
jobs.description:
Who we need

We are looking for someone who has learned system design discipline in a big-tech engineering environment and structured problem-solving, stakeholder handling and delivery rigour in a consulting environment — and who has since applied both to physical commodity trading.
You will sit inside the technology delivery team. Your job is to convert how business actually works into the design artefacts a development team builds from: process models, decision rules, data models, event definitions, state machines, and acceptance criteria. You are the person who makes sure the system that gets built reflects the real mechanics of the commodity trade lifecycle.

What this role is not

This is not
an economist or market analyst role. No market fundamentals, price forecasting, supply/demand balances or trading research.
This is not
a strategy or corporate development role. No market entry assessments, business cases for investment, or operating model strategy decks.
This is not
a pure project management or delivery coordination role, though you will own sequencing within your workstreams.

It is a hands-on systems design role, embedded in a business architecture team, producing artefacts that are consumed directly by product owners, architects and engineers.

What you will do

Design the business architecture of the platform

Model business processes across Trading, Finance, Logistics and Risk as structured, decomposable process definitions — not narrative descriptions
Define the business entity model and data dictionary: entities, attributes, relationships, identifiers, cardinality, lifecycle ownership
Specify state models for the core objects of the commodity trade lifecycle including valid transitions and the events that trigger them
Maintain a business rules catalogue — conditions, decision tables, tolerances, thresholds and their owners — separated cleanly from process flow

Turn design into buildable specification

Write functional specifications and acceptance criteria precise enough that an engineer can implement without reinterpreting the business intent
Translate operational workflows into system logic: validations, calculations, allocations, postings, and automated decisions
Specify integration contracts and data flows between the trading platform, finance systems and external services
Work with architects and engineers through build and test, validating that delivered behaviour matches the design

Own the decision record

Run design decisions to closure: frame the options, present the trade-offs and risks honestly, secure the decision, record it
Maintain a decision log and a register of open items, assumptions and change requests
Prioritise across releases, sequencing scope on business value and technical dependency

Work with stakeholders

Elicit requirements directly from business stakeholders— including reconciling what they say they do with industry best-practices
Present designs and recommendations to senior stakeholders, including trading and operations leadership
Design the change-management dimension into the solution itself: role definitions, controls, adoption safeguards, and migration away from spreadsheet-based practice

Applied AI

Design AI-enabled and automated steps inside commercial workflows — document extraction, validation, drafting, anomaly detection — with clear boundaries on where a human decision is mandatory

What we expect

Experience in a large technology organisation (product, platform or engineering environment) with exposure to formal system design practice
Experience in a top-tier management consultancy or equivalent professional services environment
Experience with physical commodity trading, energy markets or CTRM systems
Fluent in both English and Russian (mandatory)
Deep working knowledge of the physical deal lifecycle
Understanding of trade finance and accounting interfaces: prepayments, invoicing, accruals, letters of credit, treasury and statutory reporting boundaries
Understanding of oil logistics of commodity trading
Demonstrable ability to produce structured design artefacts — process models (BPMN or equivalent), entity-relationship and data models, state diagrams, decision tables, interface specifications
Comfort working directly in an engineering delivery cadence: backlog, refinement, acceptance, release
Precision with terminology and versioned documentation
Strong commercial and financial analysis capability applied to system design questions
Location: Dubai, alternatively remote with regular travel to Dubai to work alongside the client's trading and operations team.

Nice to have

Crude, refined products or LNG flows specifically
Risk management functions: exposure, credit limits, position management, VaR
Pricing and reference data: Platts, Argus, ICE, forward curves, netbacks
Event-driven or microservices architecture experience; familiarity with event sourcing
Experience with CTRM platforms as implementation lead, BA or power user
Hands-on use of LLMs and automation tooling in a commercial delivery context
Chartering or shipping S&P exposure

Why this role

Direct influence over the architecture and roadmap of a trading platform being built from the ground up
Work at the point where deep physical trading knowledge meets modern platform engineering
High ownership: you define the design, you defend it, you see it built

Build robust software solutions. Join our innovation team developing and implementing technical solutions that solve real business challenges. Design, build, and scale software that directly impacts how our organization works. At Deloitte.

Benefits

Continuous professional growth. Join our development program.
A work-from-home office setup allowance to make sure you have everything you need for an ergonomically designed workstation and internet allowance.
Work part-time (32 hours a week) or full-time (40 hours a week).
Flexible and hybrid working, in accordance with team and client commitments.
26 days of paid annual leave, and the opportunity to purchase additional leave.
A good mobility scheme: the choice of various options such as a lease car, travel by public transport, a cash option or a combination of these.
A laptop and iPhone. The iPhone can also be used for personal purposes.
A time for time arrangement that creates flexibility for personal moments that matter.
A good pension scheme with a personal contribution of only 2%.
An opportunity to take part in our collective health insurance scheme.
An opportunity to benefit from tax-efficient facilities such as company fitness, a bicycle scheme or the opportunity to lease a bicycle.
The opportunity to use 55 hours of babysitting service per calendar year if your child is 12 years old or younger.
A flexible budget, which you can use to make choices in flexible benefits, for example purchasing extra leave days or financing a bicycle plan.
Various leave options tailored to meet your individual needs, from parental leave (also for rainbow families) to the flexibility of exchanging three national holidays for non-national holidays.

Be the true you

We have a dynamic way of working, which means not all our solutions work with the same stack. One day you’re building the newest prototype we’d like to develop for our Audit department, the next day one of our battle-tested solutions requires its monthly software update. Your mental context window allows you to do both in the same week, in addition to this expectation, we are looking for someone that identifies with the following profile:

Has a few years of experience with developing production-grade software using C#, Java, Python or TypeScript and is well-versed in architectures that are usually occurring in those languages.
Previously has worked with technology that enables those products, think of AWS, GCP or Azure
Experience packaging and running applications in containers, using Docker and an orchestrator such as Kubernetes.
Have collaborated with other developers via Git, using a platform like GitHub or Azure DevOps
Able to communicate about their work, both the outcome and process, estimations and possible issues

What impact will you make?

Team Tomorrow is a team of ~90 employees with a very wide array of skills. We’re innovating how Deloitte works by optimizing internal processes, implementing novel technical solutions, and generally elevating how our colleague’s work. As a Software Engineer, you’re part of our group of Builders. We are responsible for delivering technical solutions, developing rapid prototype(s) and serving as experts for our colleagues that are not involved in the technical part of these solutions.

How do you do this?

As a Software Engineer, you will be actively involved in the development of our solutions in collaboration with designers, product owners and other engineers, as well as stakeholders in the business. You have a curious mind, in the age of AI simply writing code doesn’t just do it for you. You want to understand how and why code works and why some solutions are used within a specific context. You have an eye for detail and take a proactive approach when creating new features and/or solutions. Your expertise is valued within all steps of the process from idea to product.

In addition to creating, you also value growth and learning for yourself and your colleagues. We invite you to learn from us and have us learn things from you. This can be about a niche subject you’re captivated by or the newest version of a front-end framework.

Beyond that, we value ownership and eminence. We don’t expect you to understand and/or master everything when you join, but we expect you to continuously learn and grow in this matter. Your basics are strong and from there, you’re open to exploring more advanced and complex patterns. AI serves as your accelerator, not as your substitution. Among all the points mentioned above, we have some indicators whether you could be suited for this role:

You have a foundational knowledge of a language like C#, Java, Python or similar and have worked with this in a production environment for a few years.
In addition, you’ve embedded frameworks or plugins using package managers and are familiar with the ecosystems that surround the mentioned languages above.
Collaboration is key, which means that you are suited to work with Git and can share your work on GitHub or a similar environment. This also means you’re able to explain your code in writing and speech.
You are a curious, creative, and social person. We don’t expect you to immediately stand in front of all of us to present, but you are communicative by nature, are okay to challenge people on their ideas and not afraid to receive constructive feedback.
Our core business is innovation, so keeping up with trends and/or taking an active role in learning new things is expected.

new_jobs.title: MES Integration Engineer (M/F/NB)
new_jobs.description:
W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma sens tylko wtedy, gdy realnie wspiera ludzi i procesy biznesowe. Wspieramy naszych klientów w tworzeniu i rozwoju systemów IT oraz rozwiązań przemysłowych, które pomagają efektywniej zarządzać produkcją, danymi i procesami operacyjnymi.

Nasz dział Industrial Platform Solutions rozwija kompetencje związane z cyfryzacją przemysłu i systemami Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES). Tworzymy rozwiązania łączące świat IT z automatyką przemysłową, wspierając zakłady produkcyjne w obszarze integracji systemów, analizy danych procesowych i nowoczesnej produkcji cyfrowej.

Pracujemy blisko biznesu i rzeczywistych procesów produkcyjnych. Stawiamy na partnerską współpracę, prostotę rozwiązań i odpowiedzialność za dostarczane systemy.

O zespole i projektach

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego i wdrażającego rozwiązania MES oparte o technologie AVEVA (Wonderware), m.in. Platformę Systemową, Model-Driven MES, Historian oraz rozwiązania integracyjne.

Realizujemy międzynarodowe projekty dla dużych firm produkcyjnych z branży spożywczej, chemicznej i przemysłowej. Obecnie prowadzimy rollouty systemów MES w zakładach na kilku kontynentach, rozwijając rozwiązania po zakończonym wdrożeniu pilotażowym.

Pracujemy projektowo – w zależności od etapu wdrożenia możesz uczestniczyć zarówno w rozwoju nowych funkcjonalności, integracji systemów, rolloutach, upgrade’ach, jak i uruchomieniach produkcyjnych.

To rola dla osoby, która dobrze odnajduje się na styku IT, systemów przemysłowych i integracji. Szukamy inżyniera, który rozumie środowisko produkcyjne, potrafi pracować z danymi i systemami MES oraz swobodnie porusza się w technicznych aspektach wdrożeń.

Pracujemy w pełni zdalnie, z możliwością korzystania z biur we Wrocławiu, Katowicach, Poznaniu i Gdańsku.

Dlaczego warto?

To rola, w której:

pracujesz przy rzeczywistych wdrożeniach MES w dużych zakładach produkcyjnych
uczestniczysz w międzynarodowych projektach związanych z cyfryzacją produkcji
rozwijasz kompetencje na styku IT, OT i systemów przemysłowych
masz kontakt z nowoczesnym środowiskiem AVEVA i rozwiązaniami klasy MES
pracujesz w projektach obejmujących różne etapy wdrożeń – od integracji po rollout i uruchomienie
zdobywasz doświadczenie w środowisku produkcyjnym o dużej skali i złożoności
współpracujesz z doświadczonymi specjalistami z obszaru MES, automatyki i integracji przemysłowych
masz możliwość rozwoju w kierunku architektury rozwiązań przemysłowych i cyfryzacji produkcji

Jeśli interesuje Cię praca blisko rzeczywistych procesów produkcyjnych i chcesz rozwijać się w obszarze systemów MES oraz integracji przemysłowych – ta rola będzie dobrym wyborem.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój, konfigurację i wdrażanie systemów MES opartych o technologie AVEVA
integrację systemów produkcyjnych z bazami danych, systemami SCADA, ERP i innymi źródłami danych
pracę z danymi procesowymi oraz rozwój logiki biznesowej systemów MES
rozwój i utrzymanie komponentów aplikacyjnych z wykorzystaniem technologii webowych i backendowych
tworzenie oraz rozwój zapytań i logiki w Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL)
udział w rolloutach, uruchomieniach i działaniach wdrożeniowych w środowiskach produkcyjnych
współpracę z klientami przy analizie wymagań i rozwoju rozwiązań
wsparcie techniczne oraz troubleshooting systemów produkcyjnych
współpracę z zespołami projektowymi, automatykami i inżynierami po stronie klienta
udział w rozwoju standardów i najlepszych praktyk w obszarze MES i integracji przemysłowych

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz doświadczenie w pracy z systemami MES, SCADA
pracowałeś/aś z technologiami AVEVA / Wonderware lub podobnymi platformami przemysłowymi
dobrze rozumiesz integrację systemów IT/OT oraz środowiska produkcyjne
masz praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy z Microsoft SQL Server i T-SQL
potrafisz analizować i rozwiązywać problemy techniczne w złożonych środowiskach systemowych
znasz podstawy programowania i swobodnie poruszasz się w technologiach takich jak C#, JavaScript, SQL lub REST API
masz doświadczenie we wdrożeniach, rolloutach lub uruchomieniach systemów
potrafisz pracować zespołowo i komunikować się z klientem technicznym oraz biznesowym
komunikujesz się swobodnie w języku angielskim

Docenimy również:

znajomość AVEVA System Platform, Historian, MES, Batch lub Work Tasks
doświadczenie z integracją systemów przemysłowych
znajomość standardów ISA-95, ISA-88 lub PackML
doświadczenie z Git oraz procesami release/deployment
doświadczenie w migracjach lub upgrade’ach systemów
znajomość technologii frontendowych, np. Angular
doświadczenie z PLC/HMI/SCADA (Siemens, ABB, Beckhoff lub inne)
doświadczenie w branży spożywczej, farmaceutycznej lub chemicznej

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

rozwój poprzez pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku i różnorodnych projektach przemysłowych
możliwość zdobywania doświadczenia w nowoczesnych rozwiązaniach MES i cyfryzacji produkcji
współpracę z doświadczonym zespołem specjalistów MES, automatyki i integracji
budżet szkoleniowy i indywidualną ścieżkę rozwoju
benefity, takie jak prywatna opieka medyczna Medicover, karta Multisport, grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie czy dofinansowanie do posiłków
elastyczność w zakresie godzin pracy i modelu współpracy
możliwość korzystania z biur we Wrocławiu, Katowicach, Poznaniu i Gdańsku
udział w inicjatywach technologicznych, wydarzeniach wewnętrznych i społecznościach tematycznych

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

Wyślij nam swoje CV – najlepiej w języku angielskim. W formularzu daj nam znać, jakie masz oczekiwania finansowe, preferowaną formę współpracy oraz od kiedy możesz rozpocząć pracę.
Sprawdzimy Twoją aplikację – przyjrzymy się Twojemu doświadczeniu w obszarze systemów MES, integracji i środowisk przemysłowych.
Rozmowa z HR (online) – partnerska rozmowa o Twoim doświadczeniu, projektach i oczekiwaniach.
Rozmowa techniczna (online) – spotkanie z osobami z zespołu projektowego, podczas którego porozmawiamy o Twoim doświadczeniu z systemami MES, SQL, integracjami i projektami wdrożeniowymi.
Feedback – po zakończeniu procesu wrócimy do Ciebie z informacją zwrotną.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

Data Systems Awareness: Solid structural knowledge of cloud data warehousing (Snowflake), pipeline concepts (AWS), and business intelligence delivery tools (ThoughtSpot, Tableau)

Domain & Validation Knowledge: Experience working within a highly regulated manufacturing environment (such as Pharma, Diagnostics, or Medical Devices). new_jobs.title: .NET-utvecklare till riskbedömning
new_jobs.description:
Att jobba som . NET utvecklare

Vill du utveckla moderna försäkringslösningar och samtidigt få möjlighet att påverka både teknik och arbetssätt?

Hos oss blir du en del av ett erfaret team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och dialog är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du får arbeta nära verksamheten och användarna, vilket ger dig snabb återkoppling på det du utvecklar och möjlighet att se hur dina lösningar används i praktiken.

Här får du dessutom vara med i en spännande teknisk förflyttning. Vi har lanserat den första versionen av vårt nya riskbedömningssystem och fortsätter nu utvecklingen samtidigt som äldre lösningar successivt ersätts.

Därför kan det här vara jobbet för dig:

Du får kombinera nyutveckling och förvaltning och följa lösningar hela vägen från kod till produktion.
Du arbetar med verksamhetskritiska lösningar som bland annat används för digital hälsodeklaration och medicinsk riskbedömning.
Du får arbeta i ett erfaret team med nära samarbete och frekvent feedback från verksamheten.
Du får möjlighet att bredda din kompetens mellan .NET och React, oavsett om din tyngdpunkt idag ligger inom backend eller frontend.
Du har flera möjliga utvecklingsvägar framåt, exempelvis mot systemansvar, Scrum Master eller mjukvaruarkitektur.

Som .NET-utvecklare arbetar du med utveckling och förvaltning av applikationerna i teamets portfölj. En viktig del är vår digitala hälsodeklaration och vårt riskbedömningssystem med regelmotor och handläggarstöd. Rollen innebär att du successivt bygger upp förståelse för helheten och tar ansvar för lösningarna även efter att de gått i produktion.

Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Är Att

utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar i .NET och React
arbeta med felsökning, incidenthantering och förvaltning
testa din egen kod och delta aktivt i code reviews
hantera release och deploy samt arbeta med Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
arbeta med SQL, integrationer och teamets olika applikationer
samarbeta med bland annat riskbedömare, processägare och andra utvecklingsteam
bidra med idéer, feedback och problemlösning tillsammans med dina kollegor.

Vi är 8 personer i teamet som består av bland annat utvecklare, testare, Product Owner, Scrum Master och mjukvaruarkitekt. Vi utgår från vårt huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm och arbetar hybrid, med en kombination av arbete på kontoret och på distans. Du rapporterar till gruppchef IT inom IT Risk & Hälsa.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig med omkring fem års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och som relativt snabbt kan bidra i teamets leveranser. Du har erfarenhet av .NET-utveckling och gärna React, men det viktiga är att du är nyfiken på helheten och vill utvecklas över gränserna mellan frontend och backend.

Du behöver kunna kommunicera väl på svenska i tal och skrift. Kunskaper inom SQL, Azure DevOps, CI/CD och releasehantering eller motsvarande är värdefulla eftersom du arbetar med hela utvecklingskedjan. Erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen är meriterande.

Som person är du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och problemlösningsorienterad med förmåga att självständigt planera ditt arbete. Du söker orsaken när problem uppstår och tar dem vidare till en lösning, vilket är viktigt i arbetet med nyutveckling, förvaltning, felsökning och incidenthantering.

Samarbete och kommunikation är en naturlig del av rollen. Du delar kunskap, lyfter frågor och kan ge och ta emot feedback på ett konstruktivt sätt. Vi uppskattar också din nyfikenhet och vilja att sätta dig in i nya områden och förstå helheten.

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef (namn på chefen) på (mailadress).

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med rekryterande chef Patric Wu via patric.wu@skandia.se eller Talent Acquisition Partner på madelene.skogh@skandia.se.

Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med varierande uppdrag hos några av regionens mest intressanta kunder. I Syd har vi kontor i Malmö, Helsingborg och Karlskrona. Vi vill gärna komma i kontakt med dig som är nyfiken på HiQ och öppen för nya utmaningar. Genom att lära känna dig, din kompetens och dina drivkrafter kan vi tillsammans hitta ett sammanhang där du kan utvecklas och göra skillnad.

Location: Gothenburg, Sweden

Role Purpose
Provide end-to-end technical leadership for enterprise solutions on the .NET platform: translating business and non-functional requirements into scalable, secure and resilient architectures, and guiding engineering teams through implementation, modernization and operational readiness.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Design
• Own high-level and detailed architecture for complex .NET applications, APIs, integrations and modernization initiatives.
• Convert functional and non-functional requirements into blueprints, component designs, interface contracts and implementation guidance.
• Select appropriate architecture patterns and assess trade-offs across scalability, performance, security, cost and maintainability.

Technical Leadership & Governance
• Give hands-on architectural direction to development, QA, DevOps, security and support teams.

• Embed secure-by-design across identity, authorization, secrets, data protection and interface security.
• Define resiliency patterns — retry, timeout, failover, HA and DR — plus performance and capacity targets.
• Ensure observability through structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards and alerting.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Facilitate technical discovery with business, product, security, infrastructure and vendor stakeholders.
• Communicate complex decisions clearly to engineering and leadership audiences.
• Maintain architecture artifacts, decision records, risk logs and technical roadmaps.

Experience & Qualifications:

• 13+ years in software engineering, with strong enterprise .NET design and delivery experience.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or IT, or equivalent experience.

• Approved, traceable, implementation-ready architecture and design artifacts.

You will be a valued member of our AI & Emerging Technology practice, working collaboratively with cross-functional engineering teams, enterprise clients, and senior business stakeholders to transform bold AI ambitions into production-grade reality.

This is not a role for those who want to follow the playbook — it's a role for those who want to write it. If you thrive at the intersection of deep technical mastery and strategic innovation, and you're passionate about shaping the next generation of intelligent systems, we want to hear from you.

In This Role, You Will

Architect and implement enterprise-grade Agentic AI solutions on Microsoft Azure — leveraging Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure Machine Learning — with well-defined data flows, component architecture, and resource optimization that scale to meet real-world enterprise demands.
Engineer advanced LLM-powered applications and RAG pipelines using Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search, building retrieval-augmented generation systems that are efficient, grounded, and production-ready.

Demonstrated ability to lead architecture discussions at the executive level — influencing technical strategy and helping clients navigate the complexities of enterprise AI transformation.
